description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. 

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our French EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach. 

We have offices in Paris and London and we offer remote working from France and the United Kingdom.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CET. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara’s mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will: 

  • Drive pipeline through personalised outreach to prospects via phone, emails and LinkedIn
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a “win as a team” environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara’s ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs’ understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Please submit an English CV with your application.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Dans un souci de clarté et d’accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l’écriture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engagé en faveur de la diversité : nous valorisons l'inclusion et l'égalité, en considérant tous les candidats sans distinction d'identité de genre, d'origine ethnique ou de religion. Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

À propos de WPP Media :

WPP est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes marques mondiales pour assurer leur croissance. Nous réunissons une intelligence média de pointe, une créativité de classe mondiale, une production de nouvelle génération, des solutions pour transformer le marketing à l’ère de l’IA et un conseil stratégique d’expert au sein d’une seule compagnie. 

Propulsés par des talents exceptionnels et WPP Open, notre plateforme de marketing agentique, nous déployons l’IA à grande échelle pour aider nos clients à naviguer dans un monde en pleines mutations et à optimiser leurs investissements marketing. 

Pour plus d’informations, visitez www.wpp.com. 

WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents, nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients. Pour plus d'informations, visitez wppmedia.com. 

Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes.

Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :

  • Être Extraordinaire en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.
  • Créer un environnement Ouvert en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.
  • Diriger avec Optimisme en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.

Rôle et missions :

Vous prendrez la responsabilité du compte MGM au sein de l’équipe OpenDoor (entité qui gère l’ensemble des LOB d’Amazon au sein de WPP Media France).

Sur ce portefeuille d'envergure, nous recherchons un Business Director – Client Lead pour incarner le conseil de haut niveau, guider les recommandations stratégiques et accompagner la montée en compétences d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire.

Vos missions principales :

  1. Vision Stratégique, Écriture & Prise de Hauteur :
  • Rédiger et porter les recommandations stratégiques globales et spécifique à chaque sortie cinéma en apportant une vraie prise de hauteur 360°.
  • Concevoir des présentations et des synthèses stratégiques à fort impact destinées aux directions marketing, comités de direction, instances internationales et réseaux de partenaires/franchisés.
  • Valoriser, structurer et incarner avec conviction l'ensemble des travaux produits par l'agence pour sublimer la valeur délivrée aux clients.
  1. Appétence Innovation & Développement de la Valeur Client :
  • Démontrer une forte curiosité et une appétence naturelle pour les sujets d'innovation média et les enjeux stratégiques clés du moment : Influence & Content / Opérations Spéciales, Event…
  • Dans une démarche conseil créatrice de valeur (et non de pur push commercial), savoir détecter dans les échanges clients les besoins émergents pour co-construire des solutions sur-mesure avec l'appui des équipes d'experts internes (Data, Studio, Activation).
  1. Leadership Managérial & Coaching Orienté Développement :
  • Encadrer et animer une équipe (Account Directors, Account Managers, Executives, Alternants).
  • S'appuyer sur la forte autonomie de l'équipe dans la gestion opérationnelle du quotidien pour adopter une posture de mentor et de coach.
  • Identifier les axes de progression individuels — notamment sur la prise de hauteur stratégique, l'écriture et la formalisation des recommandations — et accompagner le développement des collaborateurs seniors pour les aider à franchir des caps majeurs.
  1. Coordination 360 & Orchestration Interne :
  • Assurer l'orchestration globale des réponses plurimédias (Online & Offline) en faisant le lien fluide entre le conseil, le planning stratégique, la création et les équipes d'activation technique (Social, Programmatique, TV/Vidéo).

Profil Recherché :

  • Expertise dans l’industrie du Cinéma, idéalement ayant déjà piloté un compte Entertainment (distributeur cinéma).
  • Expertise Média 360 : Solide culture générale des médias (Off & Online).
  • Qualités Rédactionnelles & Synthèse : Excellence reconnue dans la réflexion et l'écriture stratégique, capacité à simplifier des problématiques complexes et à porter des dossiers stratégiques de haut niveau.
  • Posture Managériale :  Capacité avérée à faire progresser ses équipes par l'accompagnement et le coaching plutôt que par le micro-management.
  • Langues : Anglais professionnel obligatoire.

La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages :

Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur.

Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité.

Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée.

Nos avantages comprennent :

  • Télétravail : jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine et 2 semaines complètes à prendre en deux fois dans l’année.
  • Congés offerts : 2 jours de repos supplémentaires offerts, dont le lundi de Pentecôte.
  • Ancienneté : Jours de congé additionnels par palier de 5 ans d’ancienneté.
  • Santé & Équité : 5 jours de télétravail additionnels par mois pour les collaboratrices souffrant d’endométriose.

  • Engagement sociétal : Missions solidaires possibles via le programme We care and we act.
  • Tools : Accès à des outils performants et à la pointe de la technologie pour la gestion des campagnes et le reporting (WPP Open).

Process de recrutement :

Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process.

  1. Entretien avec l’équipe Recrutement : Un premier entretien téléphonique ou par vidéoconférence avec l’équipe Talent pour aborder votre parcours et échanger sur le poste.
  2. Entretiens Opérationnels : Une rencontre avec les leads des comptes à gérer. Au moins un entretien physique est prévu dans nos locaux.
  3. Étude de cas : Réalisation d'un Business Case stratégique pour évaluer votre capacité d'analyse, de synthèse, la qualité de votre écriture et votre vision média.

WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle.

You own Ockto's security programme, from risk and controls to incidents, suppliers and audits. You track developments such as eIDAS2 and the EU Digital Identity Wallet, NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and the AI Act, assess what they mean for Ockto and our clients, and translate them into our security strategy and standards in time. What you get You get a role with real influence on how far clients, supervisors and consumers can trust Ockto. • Ownership of security at a company where assurance is one of the reasons clients choose us. • A real mandate: a direct line to the CEO on security matters, a voice early in product and architecture decisions, and the final word on accepting serious security risk. • Influence on what we build next, as Ockto grows into new markets and propositions. • Short lines and room to shape the security function the way it should work. • Experienced colleagues across product, engineering and compliance. description:
Mission Brief

Support our CTO and help us keep Europe's launch capability on track! As Chief of Staff to the CTO, you will act as the CTO's deputy in the internal programme and product forums, sitting in the rooms where technical decisions are made on their behalf. You will understand how our programmes actually run, spot bottlenecks before they materialise, and drive the teams that hit them back onto a credible path.

This is an engineering role first. You are not a representative of the CTO externally — you are the person who covers for them internally when they cannot be in the room, and who makes things happen in their place.

Your role in our space mission

  • Deputise for the CTO in product and programme meetings, reviews and decision forums, and carry the outcome back with a clear view of what was decided and what it means
  • Build a deep, current understanding of how each programme runs — dependencies, critical paths, interfaces between engineering, production, quality and AIT — rather than relying on status reporting
  • Identify bottlenecks early, before they turn into schedule or cost problems, and drive their resolution with the responsible teams
  • Take ownership of programmes that have drifted, define the corrective path and get them back on track
  • Provide the CTO with a technically grounded, unfiltered view of programme health and the risks that are not yet visible in the plans
  • Follow up on decisions and commitments made in the CTO's name, and close them out or escalate them early
  • Spend real time in the labs, on the shop floor and in AIT to form your own judgement

Qualification Checklist 

  • Degree in engineering or a comparable technical discipline, with several years of hands-on engineering or programme experience in aerospace, space, defence or another complex hardware environment
  • Have delivered or recovered hardware programmes with real technical, cost and schedule risk — ideally through development, industrialisation or ramp-up
  • Understand how complex technical programmes actually fail, and can find the constraint before it becomes critical
  • Technically credible enough to follow a design review, a production-readiness argument and an AIT non-conformance, without pretending to be the deepest expert in the room
  • Work through influence rather than line authority, and are trusted by VPs, Chief Engineer and Programm leads alike
  • Communicate clearly and directly at executive level, in writing and in the room
  • Speak English fluently; German is a strong plus for internal and works-council contexts

 

Benefits 

  • Employee Participation Program: Share in our success through our virtual company share program

  • And Much More! Discover additional perks and benefits when you join our team.         

Who we are

We are Isar Aerospace and we are at the forefront of New Space building a modern space business to enable faster, better and cheaper access to space.

Our mission is to help democratise space and use it for good in order to improve life on Earth now and for the future generations.

The Gecko platform is the core engine of our product experience. To maintain competitiveness and user satisfaction, we must move beyond surface-level metrics to understand the deep correlations between engine performance and real-world user behavior. We currently face challenges with data quality, such as bot contamination in nightly telemetry, which obscures our understanding of true performance trends. A dedicated analyst is required to bridge the gap between engineering telemetry and actionable product strategy, ensuring that leadership has high-fidelity data to prioritize performance guardrails and technical budgets.

Engineering Deliverables

  • Automated Dashboards: Create and maintain high-level overview dashboards that translate complex performance data into consumable formats for Product Managers and leadership.
  • Telemetry Gap Analysis: Audit the Gecko codebase to identify missing collection points or "probes" necessary for a complete understanding of the product experience.
  • Data Sanitization Frameworks: Develop methodologies and tools to identify and filter data inconsistencies, specifically focusing on isolating bot traffic and hardware-specific noise from telemetry streams.
  • Behavioral Inference Reports: Deliver deep-dive analyses correlating technical performance shifts (e.g., LCP, eTLD+1) with user-facing pain points and engagement trends.

Scope, Skills, and Effort Estimate

Scope

The analyst will focus exclusively on Gecko engine telemetry across multiple platforms (Desktop and Android), collaborating with the Performance Team, Data Team, and Product Leadership.

Required Skills

  • Technical: Advanced SQL (BigQuery/Redash), proficiency in data visualization using AI tooling, and experience with statistical analysis (e.g., Pearson’s correlation, multivariate analysis). Knowledge of Rust/C++ is a strong plus. Strong proficiency with AI tools like Claude Code, Codex, or similar is highly desirable. 
  • Domain Knowledge: Ability to understand browser component interactions and their impact on user experience.
  • Soft Skills: Proven ability to work independently, translating technical requirements into business insights.

3363 - Director, Data Strategy, UK (FTC)

We are seeking a Director to join our Data Strategy team for our major UK telco client, BTEE.
The BTEE team (aka OpenConnect) is one of the largest UK client in the agency and the data work on the account is innovative and future-facing, with clients who are data savvy and champion our work across their business.
This role is focused on the Consumer side of the BT Group business and will work across three of BT Group’s sub-brands; BT, EE and Plusnet.

Data Strategy involves transforming the way our clients think about, organize and orchestrate data & technology to deliver more timely, engaging and meaningful brand experience for their customers. 

BT Consumer is a data rich client and that combined with clients willingness to test and evolve makes for opportunities to do agency leading work. Work is recognised by awards, agency-first’s and also TelCo-firsts for the EMEA market. This role will be part of an agency-team-wide-push to adopt AI and drive innovation to drive client outcomes.

 

The main focus area of this role are as below;


Data-led audience and bidding strategy enablement;

Leadership

description:
Director, Development Cost & Capital Planning (EMEA) 

Location: London, hybrid, with regular travel to project locations across EMEA

About Nscale

At Nscale, we are building the infrastructure for Europe’s AI revolution. Nscale is developing cutting-edge sovereign generative AI solutions, powered by a new generation of high-performance, sustainable data centres and GPUs built specifically for AI workloads. 

The growth of artificial intelligence is driving unprecedented global demand for compute and GPU infrastructure. Nscale is positioned at the heart of this transformation — building the platforms that will enable the next decade of innovation. 

Nscale is working closely with the world’s most advanced AI technology providers, integrating next-gen compute hardware and GPU clusters in both partner and Nscale built facilities. This is a unique opportunity to join Nscale’s journey, play a key role in delivering transformative AI infrastructure, and help shape a company scaling globally with a key focus in the EMEA region.

The Role

The Director, Development Cost & Capital Planning is accountable for establishing cost certainty, capital planning, development risk and commercial viability across Nscale's EMEA Development portfolio from site identification (Gate 0) through due diligence (Gate 1) to development sanction and ‘shovel-ready’ transition into Delivery (Gate 2).

The role owns L0 Indicative Estimates, L1 Estimated Budgets and L2 Schematic Design Budget for every EMEA opportunity, consolidating the development, energy, design, construction, procurement and AI infrastructure workstream budgets into a single Total Development Cost (TDC) providing the commercial and financial foundation for site selection, land and lease acquisitions, Colocation leases, underwriting business cases, investment committee approvals and project approvals.

Operating as an individual contributor at first, the role will personally prepare estimates, cost models, risk registers, benchmarking and investment-grade business cases while establishing the systems, governance and processes required for future growth. The role will develop to manage a high performing team supporting the Development function as it expands across the EMEA region.

Key Responsibilities

  • Development Cost Planning & Estimating - Own L0, L1 and L2 estimates across the EMEA portfolio, maintaining the Total Development Cost (TDC), proforma and development cost baseline through Gate 2. Where early stage budgets have missing elements, propose and agree estimates and placeholders with the project team.
  • Investment Underwriting & Business Case Development - Provide CAPEX, contingency, cash flow and cost-risk inputs to support acquisitions, business cases and Investment Committee approvals.
  • Development Risk Management and Contingency Planning - Maintain project risk registers and govern contingency in accordance with Nscale policy.
  • Site Selection & Land Acquisition Support - Support site screening, due diligence and acquisition decisions through cost, risk and abnormality assessments.
  • Power, Utilities & Infrastructure Assessment - Integrate power, utility and enabling infrastructure costs and schedules into the overall development budget.
  • Procurement & Strategic Supply Chain Integration - Work with Procurement and Strategic Sourcing to incorporate market capacity, procurement strategy, long-lead items and supply chain risks into estimates.
  • Cost Benchmarking - Maintain EMEA cost benchmarks, escalation assumptions and market intelligence across key jurisdictions.
  • Contract / Lease Support - Support the Development team in all areas of land / power acquisition and Colocation leasing and contracting, providing cost annexes in the agreed contract form.
  • Market Intelligence - Retain current market benchmark costs and reintegrate as-built costs of developments into pre-development modelling and estimates.
  • Portfolio Capital Planning & Forecasting - Lead portfolio CAPEX forecasting, cashflow planning and variance reporting for all pre-sanction opportunities.
  • Development Governance & Gateway Approvals - Own cost deliverables, assurance and reporting for Gate 0-2 approvals.
  • Global WBS Alignment and Handover into Delivery - Structure all estimates to the Global WBS and lead commercial transition to Delivery at Gate 2.
  • Lessons Learned and Estimating Accuracy Improvement - Improve estimate accuracy, benchmarking and contingency calibration through estimate-to-outturn analysis.
  • Functional Leadership and Future Team Development - Act as EMEA lead for development cost planning, establishing standards, tools and governance with responsibility for building and leading the team as the portfolio scales.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of experience in quantity surveying, cost management, estimating, commercial management or capital planning.
  • Proven experience within hyperscale data centres, mission critical facilities, major infrastructure, energy or industrial developments. 
  • The ability to build experienced based cost plans and budgets when limited information exists.
  • Strong understanding of the full data centre development lifecycle from site origination, early stage development, planning, permitting through construction mobilisation.
  • Experience preparing the cost basis for investment-grade business cases and underwriting budgets.
  • Experience developing risk registers, contingency models and portfolio capital plans.
  • Strong understanding of contractor markets, procurement strategies and supply chain dynamics.
  • Experience working with developers, investors, lenders, consultants and contractors.
  • Demonstrated ability to present to Executive Committees, Investment Committees and Board stakeholders.
  • Fluency in data centre cost benchmarking (€/MW, €/m², cost per IT load) and the development cost drivers of power, cooling and AI-ready infrastructure.
  • Working knowledge of EMEA contract forms and procurement routes (e.g. FIDIC, NEC and local equivalents) and their cost and risk implications.
  • Proficiency with estimating and cost management tools and advanced Excel-based cost and cash flow modelling.
  • Right to work [UK / EU] and willingness to travel across EMEA.

Preferred:

  • Degree in Quantity Surveying, Construction Economics, Commercial Management, Engineering or related discipline.
  • MRICS, CICES, ACostE or equivalent professional accreditation preferred but not essential.
  • Experience across multiple EMEA jurisdictions.
  • Experience supporting large-scale AI, cloud, hyperscale or mission-critical developments.

description: Who is Sonar? Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. Position description Sonar is scaling its go-to-market engine across Sales, Customer Success, and post-sales teams in every region. As the company grows, the field needs operating changes that are consistent, measurable, and adopted, not a collection of regional fixes. This role exists to design, land, and measure those changes. As Director, Global Field Operations, you will sit in Revenue Operations as an individual contributor at Principal level, dedicated 100% to global field operations initiatives. You will not carry a regional support remit. You will own the portfolio of initiatives that change how the global field plans, sells, forecasts, and retains customers, from problem definition through rollout to measured business impact. You will be judged on outcomes such as conversion, pipeline coverage, forecast accuracy, productivity, and retention, not on the volume of activity delivered. What You'll Do Own a portfolio of global field initiatives end to end: problem definition, business case, design, rollout, and post-launch review. Prioritise on expected impact and effort, and stop or pivot initiatives that are not moving their target metric. Define the baseline, target, KPI, and owner for every initiative before launch, and report outcomes (conversion rate, sales cycle, forecast accuracy, attainment, renewal, and expansion) rather than activity. Build and run change plans: stakeholder mapping, communication cadence, interlock with enablement, adoption tracking, and feedback loops. Explain the why behind each change in the language of the audience, from reps and front-line managers to the CRO and ELT. Stay close to the field through deal reviews, pipeline inspection, and field sessions. Collect feedback continuously, adapt the approach quickly, and close the loop with the people who gave it. Align Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Enablement, Finance, and Systems on priorities, sequencing, and ownership, often without direct authority. Balance regional needs against global standards. Standardise global processes and operating cadence (forecast, pipeline inspection, QBRs) for scalability and repeatability. Provide narrative and analysis for QBRs, leadership meetings, and strategic discussions, linking initiative results to ARR, NRR, and GRR. Experience & Qualifications The ideal candidate will: Bring 5+ years in sales operations, field operations, revenue operations, or a related function in B2B SaaS. We welcome current ICs, and managers willing to move into an IC role for the medium term (1+ years). Have a track record of delivering global initiatives with measurable business outcomes, and before and after metrics to show for it. Have led process, tooling, or organisational changes that the field adopted, with proven change management and communication skills at every level up to executive. Have field credibility: you have worked directly with Sales Leaders and sellers, and both trust you. Take feedback well and pivot quickly without losing sight of the outcome. Build strong relationships and influence across the GTM organisation without relying on direct authority. Combine business, strategy, and analytical capability, including forecasting, pipeline, and productivity analysis, and be able to articulate trends in churn, expansion, ARR, NRR, GRR, LTV, and CAC. Be hands-on with Salesforce, Google Sheets/Excel, and Tableau. AI power user. Operate with an owner mindset, and be comfortable diving deep and navigating ambiguity. Nice to have: experience in post-sales or Customer Success Operations (a plus, not a requirement); experience in a high-growth SaaS company, including a high-volume, PLG, or inbound-demand funnel; experience rolling out initiatives across regions in a multinational organisation. In-office culture We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Flight Control Systems team at Stark is responsible for safety-critical architectures, control laws, and integrated flight software across autonomous defense platforms. Working closely with systems engineering, aerodynamics, and software teams, we bridge theoretical control theory and field-tested hardware deployment. Our mission is to ensure robust, high-performance, and resilient flight behavior in highly dynamic and contested environments.

YOUR MISSION

As Director of Flight Control Systems (FCS), reporting directly to our VP of Hardware, you will lead the end-to-end development, verification, and qualification of next-generation flight control architectures. You will define the technical roadmap, build and mentor an elite team of control and software engineers, and oversee safety-critical flight law implementation from initial modeling to flight testing.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Lead and scale the Flight Control Systems team, setting engineering standards, performance goals, and development roadmaps.
  • Drive the architectural design of fly-by-wire flight control software, sensor fusion algorithms, and actuation control loops.
  • Oversee Model-in-the-Loop (MIL), Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing and verification frameworks.
  • Collaborate with systems engineering and flight test crews to validate control system performance during flight test campaigns.
  • Ensure compliance with safety-critical aerospace and defense standards (e.g., DO-178C, DO-254, or military flight clearance frameworks).
  • Interface with internal cross-functional leadership and external partners to align system requirements with platform capabilities.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Control Theory, or a related technical field.
  • Proven leadership experience managing engineering teams in flight control systems or safety-critical aerospace development.
  • Deep expertise in flight dynamics, control laws development (PID, LQR, H-infinity, adaptive control), and MATLAB/Simulink modeling.
  • Hands-on background in auto-code generation, embedded C/C++ development, and flight software integration.
  • Track record of taking flight control systems from initial concept through ground and flight testing.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with autonomous defense platforms or unmanned aerial systems (UAS).
  • Familiarity with military certification processes and flight test safety protocols.
  • Knowledge of modern software development practices (CI/CD, automated testing, Git).

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

 

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Reporting to the Senior Director, Performance Marketing, you will develop and execute strategic plans, use analytics to inform decisions, and drive execution to optimize marketing budgets against company profitability goals. 

This is a high-impact role with the opportunity to work with teams across the organisation, from Pricing & Discounts, MarTech and Analytics. From the start, we would like you to focus on transforming our search stack to be competitive for years to come, identifying and driving strategic investments across Google, Bing, and OpenAI, working with our in-house experts and dedicated technical/account management teams to formulate Joint Business/technical Plans and build the infrastructure that will drive HelloFresh's paid search future. 

What you’ll do: The Recipe

  • Transform and architect the search stack: Design and build a modern, scalable, future-proof paid search infrastructure across Google, Bing, and OpenAI that positions HelloFresh for sustained competitive advantage 
  • Conduct comprehensive audits to bring our Search account setup to industry 'best in class' standards across all three platforms, identifying gaps and modernisation opportunities 
  • Own the paid search strategy strategy, set and drive the strategic direction across search channels, supporting the move into the next autonomous era 
  • Manage global budget allocation: Set and dynamically reallocate budget across markets, brands, and channels to hit volume growth and CPA/CAC targets, forecasting and reporting with rigour.
  • Lead senior agency and platform relationships: Act as the strategic lead and escalation point for external agencies and platform partners (including Google, DSPs, and mobile platforms), setting the agenda on plans, investment, and innovation.
  • Work closely with Marketing Analytics to execute tests across search portfolios to measure incrementality and marginal efficiency and consequently optimise in-house systems and algorithms to profitably scale our Search marketing programmes 
  • Act as a close partner to MarTech teams to bring the search staack into the next stage of automation 

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients 

  • A Bachelor's degree with a strong academic record and/or proven relevant experience in a performance marketing or highly commercial role within D2C or subscription-based businesses 
  • 8+ years experience in Google Advertising ecosystem, either from an agency or client-side role

  • Early experience or exposure to OpenAI's Search offering or emerging AI-driven search platforms 
  • 5+ years experience in team management and leadership roles 
  • Proven experience building and embedding incrementality-based measurement frameworks (e.g. geo-testing, regression, multi-touch attribution) and partnering with Analytics on marketing mix modelling (MMM) and advanced measurement.
  • Expert knowledge of Google bidding, targeting, and optimisation

  • An entrepreneurial mindset: you embrace ownership, make bold, data-driven decisions, and relentlessly pursue innovative solutions to drive sustainable growth. Comfortable navigating ambiguity, testing new approaches, and learning from both successes and failures.

Aided by support from the broader team, the Partnerships Director will define client’s JBPs with media partners, such as Google, Amazon, Pinterest, Meta and TikTok, to maximise client benefits, and then work to deliver these commercial and strategic benefits, throughout the year.  Cooperation with, and co-ordination of, local and regional market teams will be central to this, to ensure a consistent approach and successful execution of the negotiated benefits.

This role will require high levels of relationship management, strategy, coordination and organization as it will involve management of a complex client and agency structure.

The Partnerships Director will need to gain a deep understanding of our client’s businesses and will need to apply their digital (and to a lesser extent, offline) landscape and strategic knowledge to ensure that the client partnership team delivers the most effective plans to deliver on the client’s objectives and the changing entertainment marketing landscape.

They will be responsible for managing partner relationships with the key digital vendors (Meta, Amazon, Google, etc.) to ensure that our clients gain maximum benefits from trading deals brokered and JBPs. Measurement is a key part of the role, so this role is also responsible for ensuring that digital investment associated with the JBPs is tracked and reported back to the client, to ensure full transparency of pacing versus any investment endeavours in place. 

Reporting of the role

This role reports to the Global Head of Partnerships.

Responsibilities of the role:

Strategic Skills

  • Work collaboratively within the WPP Media network, and specialist practice departments e.g. DPAM teams, Brand Safety and Governance, , to deliver innovative and media-first, cross media Global JBP opportunities
  • Develop a strong understanding of media landscape working closely with on and offline Global partners, to ensure first mover opportunities are leveraged for client
  • Support in development and monitoring of opportunities with key vendors in the Diversity, Sustainability and Inclusion space, helping to grow client spend
  • Identify key areas of partnership growth and work collaboratively with client teams, as an extension to their strategy & planning teams, to deliver and activate Global JBPs
  • Support in the deployment and monitoring of Global JBPs, across local markets and regions, to ensure targets are met and value is unlocked

External Relationship Management

  • Demonstrate an ability to build and maintain strong working relationships with clients, global media vendors, proprietary media opcos and internal teams, to drive collaboration and best in class delivery
  • Develop and sell partnerships persuasively and with confidence, passion and enthusiasm to both clients and internal stakeholders

Delivery Excellence 

  • Present confidently, with gravitas & impact
  • Proactively share global marketplace updates and work with markets to do the same

New business 

  • Support where needed in new business pitches and proposals, supporting client and strategy teams in content partnership proposals in group pitches

General tasks:

  • Develop a full understanding of in all areas of the WPP Media and agency suite of products and services, in order to speak confidently with clients about them, ultimately increasing client adoption
  • Deliver best in class JBPs, ensuring client value, innovation and excellence are delivered
  • Develop global integrated investment strategy and then actively work with regional and local leads to deploy in markets, adapting as needed
  • Work closely with Regional and Market leads to support in roll out of investment frameworks & JBP benefits
  • Develop best in class campaign measurement frameworks and build out case studies of the best case studies, to be socialized within local and regional teams, as well and with the client directly
  • Develop, deploy, and monitor client’s global inclusive marketing investment roadmap, partnering with global strategy and integrations leads
  • Partner with global lead on media quality processes and governance and ensure same rigor applied to all media
  • Actively scout for new opportunities bespoke to the GroupM client set
  • Manage monthly partner investment pacing against agreed JBP endeavours, ensuring correct framework is in place to hit spend thresholds across regions and markets
  • Brief and manage set up of client QBR and JBP reviews coordinating with regions and markets where required

People Responsibilities: 

  • Develop relationships with both clients as well as internally at WPP Media
  • Build trusted relationships with media vendors, proprietary media opcos and internal stakeholder teams
  • Manage, motivate and encourage growth and skillset of junior members of the team

Skills and Experience

  • Leading by example, with integrity and good citizenship
  • Positive and passionate approach that motivates the team
  • Independently owning and managing relationships confidently
  • Ambition and drive to execute new ideas and be at the forefront of new industry developments

Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.  

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country. 

Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location 

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) for more information on how we process the information you provide. 

 

While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

description: Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on. Within our Underwater Security business we develop sensing technologies that help detect and monitor underwater threats. Our solutions include OptiBarrier, designed for immediate, over-the-horizon threat detection, and OptiArray, our low-power optical thin-line towed array for unmanned underwater vehicles and submarines. Role Overview As a Hardware Test Engineer at Optics11, you play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our fiber-optic sensing systems. You develop and execute hardware tests at board and sub-system level, identifying potential issues early and helping our engineers deliver robust, production-ready solutions. Combining hands-on hardware engineering with test automation, you build test setups, analyze results, support prototype development, and help transfer testing processes from R&D to production. You will be part of our Sensing Platform Team, working closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, production, and external partners. What You'll Do Hardware Testing & Automation Develop and execute test plans and procedures for electronic boards, assemblies, and sub-systems. Design and maintain test setups, fixtures, and jigs for functional, electrical, and optical testing. Perform environmental, stability, and robustness testing, including thermal cycling, vibration, and EMC/ESD pre-compliance. Develop Python-based test automation for instrument control, data logging, and analysis. Document test procedures, results, and findings, ensuring clear traceability and reproducibility. Prototyping & Production Support Support prototype assembly, soldering, rework, cable assembly, and fiber handling and splicing. Develop and improve production and Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) setups, procedures, and test jigs. Support troubleshooting, repairs, and root-cause investigations during development and production. Maintain an organized, safe, and well-equipped R&D laboratory, including equipment calibration and materials management. Technical Analysis & Continuous Improvement Analyze test results to evaluate hardware performance, identify risks, and support engineering decisions. Investigate hardware failures and collaborate with design engineers on corrective actions. Contribute to design-for-test and design-for-manufacturing improvements. Identify opportunities to improve test methods, automation, and product reliability. Collaboration & Delivery Work closely with Electronics, Photonics, Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, IVVQ, and production teams. Support the handover of tested hardware and documentation to integration, validation, and production teams. Independently plan and execute assigned activities, communicating progress, risks, and dependencies. Share technical knowledge, contribute to design reviews, and support continuous improvement across the team. What we offer Join one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech scale-ups. Real impact: your work directly shapes our growth and success. A great team in an international organization with colleagues from more than twenty nationalities. A competitive salary and benefits package. 30 days of holiday per year. Fresh team lunches five times a week, plus regular team activities and company events. Qualifications BSc (HBO) in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, Applied Physics, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience. 2+ years of relevant experience in hardware testing, test engineering, prototyping, or lab work on electronic or electro-optical products. Hands-on experience with laboratory instruments such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, signal generators, and data loggers; experience with optical power meters is an advantage. Experience executing test plans and procedures, logging and analyzing measurement data, and documenting results in clear test reports. Good soldering and rework skills for through-hole and SMD components, including building custom cables and harnesses, and the ability to read schematics, PCB layouts, wiring diagrams, and assembly drawings. Experience with or good understanding of environmental testing (e.g. temperature, thermal cycling, vibration) and of EMC/ESD principles. Python skills for test automation, instrument control, and data analysis; experience with LabVIEW, embedded Linux or similar tools is advantageous. Awareness of ESD-safe working practices and lab safety, including laser safety, or willingness to be trained. A structured, practical, and hands-on working style, and real enjoyment of testing, finding problems, and getting hardware to work. Good communication skills in English and a collaborative working style. Eligible for EU/NATO security clearance. Preferred Experience with fiber handling, connector cleaning and inspection, and fusion splicing. Experience with EMC pre-compliance measurements (e.g. EN 55032/CISPR 32 emissions, IEC 61000-4-x immunity) or environmental test standards (e.g. IEC 60068, MIL-STD-810). IPC certification (e.g. IPC-A-610 or IPC J-STD-001) or experience with ESD control programs (IEC 61340-5-1). Experience developing production test setups, test jigs, or programming fixtures, or supporting NPI and production transfer with electronics manufacturing partners. Experience in multidisciplinary high-tech product development (e.g. sensing, photonics, instrumentation, defence, or subsea). Screening You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. You will work closely with R&D, Quality, Production team and suppliers to support the ramp-up and the continuous improvement of our instruments manufacturing lines. Duties & Responsibilities : • Lead the industrialization, design transfer and manufacturing ramp-up of new product or new feature introduction project related to surgical instruments, accessories and their components, in close partnership with R&D, Quality, Contract Manufacturers and Suppliers. • Analyse the cost of the instrument, review the manufacturing processes and components, identify, evaluate and implement cost reduction opportunities. • Drive continuous improvement of manufacturing processes using data-driven problem-solving and root-cause analysis to improve yield, quality, cost and efficiency. • Lead manufacturing process development, validation or verification and equipment qualification activities. • Contribute to the improvement of test strategies, and to the definition and implementation of on-line and end-of-line testing, from requirements to test design and qualification. • Initiate, assess and lead Manufacturing Change Requests in coordination with R&D, Quality, Contract Manufacturer and suppliers. description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary and Impact 

This role is within The Goat Agency, a leading brand within WPP Media, where you will be instrumental in helping global brands harness the power of social and creator-led content to deliver measurable impact. Recognised as a global leader in the space, we deliver award-winning campaigns in more than 70 countries. With over 650 social natives worldwide, we create ambitious influencer programmes from tactical activations to long-term partnerships, designed to drive awareness, engagementand conversions across the full marketing funnel. 

Role Overview: The Influencer Director (Goat), Europe, serves as a critical strategic and operational partner to the Head of EMEA, serving as a key strategic and operational enabler in overseeing and developing the European market. This role is instrumental in supporting the execution of regional strategy, driving key projects, and ensuring local market leads are equipped for success. You will contribute significantly to maintaining operational excellence, fostering strong relationships, and enabling the successful delivery of results across Goat’s European presence. While an individual contributor role, it requires a high degree of autonomy in project management and the ability to influence cross-functional teams.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Strategic Support & Operational Enablement:
  • Act as the primary support to Goat EMEA leadership in translating regional objectives into actionable plans and ensuring their successful execution.
  • Assist in the development and implementation of regional strategies, processes, and best practices to drive market growth and operational efficiency.
  • Prepare comprehensive reports, presentations, and analyses for Goat EMEA leadership, providing data-driven insights to inform strategic decision-making.
  • Represent Goat EMEA leadership in internal meetings and discussions as required, providing updates and ensuring alignment.
  1. Project Leadership & Execution:
  • Take ownership of, and lead, key strategic projects and initiatives across the European markets, ensuring timely delivery and high-quality outputs.
  • Manage project scopes, timelines, resources, and stakeholder communications for assigned initiatives, proactively identifying and mitigating risks.
  • Collaborate closely with local market leads, global teams (e.g., Growth, Group Solutions, Campaign Delivery), and external partners to ensure seamless project integration and successful outcomes.
  • Troubleshoot operational challenges within projects and support the Head of EMEA in resolving broader market-specific issues, proposing effective and efficient solutions.
  1. Relationship & Stakeholder Coordination:
  • Cultivate and maintain effective working relationships with local market leads, key internal stakeholders across Goat, and WPP Media colleagues, facilitating collaboration and clear communication.
  • Serve as a central point of contact for various internal teams seeking input or guidance on European market initiatives, escalating to Goat EMEA leadership as necessary.
  • Support Goat EMEA leadership in fostering a cohesive and high-performance culture by coordinating internal communications and sharing best practices across European teams.

Skills and Competencies:

  • Senior Project & Operational Management Experience: Proven track record (typically 5+ years) in a senior project management, operational support, or strategic coordination role within a digital marketing, advertising, or influencer marketing agency, with significant exposure to European markets.
  • Collaborative Leadership: Demonstrated ability to effectively partner with senior leadership as a trusted strategic and operational enabler, supporting strategic initiatives and driving execution through influence and collaboration rather than direct authority.
  • Exceptional Organizational & Problem-Solving Skills: Highly organized with meticulous attention to detail, capable of managing multiple complex projects concurrently and adept at identifying, analysing, and solving operational challenges.
  • Strong Communication & Presentation Abilities: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex information clearly, prepare compelling presentations, and effectively engage with diverse stakeholders.
  • Strategic Acumen: Ability to understand high-level strategic objectives and translate them into actionable plans, contributing insightful perspectives to regional discussions.
  • Market & Ecosystem Knowledge: Familiarity with the European media, marketing, and creator economy landscape, and an understanding of agency operations and dynamics within the WPP network.
  • Proactive & Self-Directed: A highly motivated self-starter who can work autonomously, take initiative, and consistently deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.  

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country. 

Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location

description: Kunden begleiten. Lösungen umsetzen. Verantwortung übernehmen. Du willst die IT deiner Kunden nicht nur am Laufen halten, sondern verstehen, weiterentwickeln und verantworten? Bei Dukers betreust du eigene Kundenumgebungen von A bis Z – mit einem Team im Rücken, das sein Wissen teilt und bei kniffligen Fragen zusammensteht. Über Dukers Dukers ist ein Spin-off der Swisscom mit Sitz in St. Gallen. Wir planen, implementieren und betreiben die IT von Organisationen, die ihre Informatik in verlässliche Hände geben wollen. Unsere Kunden erhalten eine Lösung aus einer Hand: Arbeitsplätze, Netzwerk, Server, Cloud-Dienste und Kommunikation werden von uns aufgebaut, laufend überwacht, aktuell gehalten und abgesichert. Unser Team besteht aus Spezialisten mit langjähriger Erfahrung – mit den Standards eines grossen Anbieters und der Verbindlichkeit eines Partners, der seine Kunden persönlich kennt. Deine Rolle Du bist die technische Ansprechperson für deine Kunden. Du kennst ihre Umgebungen, betreibst sie zuverlässig und setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um – von der Konfiguration über die Inbetriebnahme bis zur Dokumentation. Bei Migrationen und grösseren Projekten arbeitest du mit unseren Spezialisten für Netzwerk, Security und Cloud zusammen. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben und entscheidest im Alltag selbst. Bei anspruchsvollen Fragen steht das Team hinter dir. Deine Aufgaben Du betreust die IT-Umgebungen deiner Kunden, kennst ihre Anforderungen und bist ihre verlässliche technische Ansprechperson. Du administrierst Microsoft-365-Tenants: Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft Defender, Exchange Online. Du betreibst Clients, Netzwerke und Serversysteme, analysierst Störungen und behebst ihre Ursachen nachhaltig. Du setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um und arbeitest bei Migrationen und Projekten mit. Du erkennst, wo eine Umgebung sicherer oder stabiler werden kann, und bringst konkrete Vorschläge ein. Du dokumentierst deine Arbeit sauber, damit jede Umgebung für das ganze Team nachvollziehbar bleibt. Womit du arbeitest Microsoft 365 und Cloud: Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Exchange Online, Azure Virtualisierung: VMware Cloud Director, Hyper-V, Proxmox Netzwerk: Ubiquiti UniFi, Cisco, HPE Aruba Security: Fortinet, Versa, Cisco Rechenzentrum: Eigene Infrastruktur in einem der sichersten und nachhaltigsten Rechenzentren der Schweiz, auf der wir unsere Lösungen und die unserer Kunden betreiben Betrieb: Backup, Monitoring und Ticketing mit Tools, die wir selbst entwickeln und weiterentwickeln Netzwerk und Security betreiben wir als Managed Services – als Value Added Reseller der Swisscom für unsere gemeinsamen Kunden. Wer hier Tiefe aufbauen will, findet bei uns das Umfeld dafür. Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich, beispielsweise als Informatiker/in EFZ, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation Erfahrung in der Administration von Microsoft-365-Umgebungen – idealerweise mit Entra ID, Intune und Defender Solide Netzwerkkenntnisse: IP-Adressierung, VLANs, DNS und DHCP sind dir vertraut, Routing und Firewall-Regelwerke kein Fremdwort Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt und die Fähigkeit, technische Themen verständlich zu erklären Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise Lernbereitschaft und Interesse, dein Wissen im Team einzubringen Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Führerausweis Kategorie B Idealerweise hast du bereits Kundenumgebungen eigenständig betreut. Stehst du noch am Anfang deiner Laufbahn, bringst aber die fachlichen Grundlagen und den Willen mit, dich einzuarbeiten, möchten wir dich ebenfalls kennenlernen. Deine Aufgaben und deine Verantwortung wachsen mit deinem Können – das Onboarding ist darauf ausgelegt. Dein Arbeitsort und deine Einsätze Dein Arbeitsalltag verbindet Einsätze bei Kunden in der Ostschweiz und im Raum Zürich mit Arbeit und Austausch in unserem Büro in der Stadt St. Gallen. Dazu kommen ein eigener kleiner Park, ein Balkon direkt am Büro mit Grill – und der Blick auf die Geissli nebenan. Was dich bei Dukers erwartet Einarbeitung, die den Namen verdient: Du startest mit einem intensiven Training und arbeitest in den ersten Wochen im Tandem mit einer erfahrenen Kollegin oder einem erfahrenen Kollegen, bis du deine Umgebungen selbst verantwortest. Und wenn du zu Hause laden willst, beteiligen wir uns an deiner eigenen Ladestation. Geschäftshandy mit Mobilabo: Gehört zur Ausstattung. Bei uns entscheidest du mit. Lernen wir uns kennen Stellenantritt: per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung. Und wenn du vor deiner Entscheidung einen Tag mit dem Team verbringen möchtest – gerne. Deine Ansprechpersonen: Livia Julia Tanner, Leitung Personal, nimmt deine Bewerbung entgegen und beantwortet Fragen zur Stelle und zu den Anstellungsbedingungen. Aaron Herceg, Gründer und Governance Manager, leitet das Engineering-Team, mit dem du arbeitest, und beantwortet deine technischen Fragen. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: initial value realization, adoption, and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role

As a Lead Deployment Architect, you are the technical authority for our strategic accounts within Celonis delivery. You shape how Celonis solutions are designed, architected, and delivered across your portfolio of strategic customer engagements. You define what good delivery looks like - setting architectural standards, designing end-to-end solution strategies, and ensuring that AI-augmented and agentic workflows are deployed effectively at scale.

You operate at the intersection of deep platform expertise, domain knowledge, and customer strategy. You are equally comfortable leading a technical design review with Celonis engineers and presenting a transformation roadmap to a customer’s C-suite. You bridge the gap between pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring that what was promised can be delivered - and often shaping the promise itself.

This role carries significant organizational leverage. You set delivery patterns that other teams follow. You define how AI agents should be orchestrated for complex, multi-workstream engagements. You work in close collaboration with Deployment Engineers and raise the bar for the entire practice.

The Work You’ll Do

Solution Architecture & Design

  • Designing secure, scalable architectures tailored to complex enterprise requirements, optimizing for long-term usage growth and high concurrency.
