  • Own solution quality & outcome delivery across engagements, conducting design reviews, and ensuring delivery teams follow architectural standards

AI Orchestration & Delivery Innovation

  • Design how AI deployment agents (Apollo) should be used across complex, multi-workstream engagements, defining agent workflows, validation checkpoints, and quality gates
  • Develop reusable specifications, templates, and patterns that enable Deployment Engineers to direct AI agents more effectively
  • Pioneer new delivery approaches that leverage AI to compress timelines, improve quality, or unlock use cases that were previously impractical
  • Set standards for AI output validation, ensuring the organization maintains quality as delivery accelerates

Customer Strategy & Advisory

  • Serve as the senior technical advisor to strategic customers, building trusted relationships with VP and C-level stakeholders
  • Translate customer business challenges into Celonis platform strategies, identifying high-impact use cases and defining success metrics
  • Support pre-sales by providing technical credibility in complex deals, validating solution feasibility, and shaping project scope
  • Guide customers through their Process Intelligence maturity journey, advising on platform expansion, AI readiness, and organizational change
  • Leverage the broader ecosystem of Celonis experts to remove potential blockers in customer engagements
  • Establish deep, technical advisor relationships with customer stakeholders (Lead Data Engineers and Architects, Head of Data Intelligence, Head of Business Transformation) to provide technical reassurance and maintain "Expert-to-Expert" alignment during the course of the deployment 

Successful Implementation

  • Work together with Deployment Engineers on delivery projects to implement the most complex and cutting edge use cases for our customers
  • Stay on top of the newest technologies Celonis has to offer and own the implementation of early stage products for our customers, ensuring close feedback cycles with Product & Engineering
  • Review Solution(s) Blueprint to ensure quality, scalability and production readiness of business critical and operational use cases

Domain & Industry Depth

  • Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals
  • Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage
  • Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain in collaboration with the Deployment Engineer, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap

Practice Development

  • Contribute to hiring: define what great looks like for the Deployment job family, conduct interviews, and calibrate candidate assessments
  • Share knowledge across the organization through internal enablement sessions, documentation, and community of practice leadership
  • Ensure the link with Product & Engineering to feed customer insights and field experience back into platform development, and to influence the platform roadmap

What Distinguishes This Role from Deployment Engineer

  • Scope: You work across multiple engagements and shape solutions across a portfolio/cluster/industry vertical (4+ concurrent clients)
  • Influence & Practice Development: your Scope allows you to identify and set standards that other teams follow - for solution architecture, AI orchestration patterns, and delivery quality
  • Bridge: You span pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring continuity between what’s sold and what’s delivered
  • Force multiplier: Your work multiplies the effectiveness of Deployment Engineers rather than substituting for it

The Qualifications You Need

  • Experience: 8+ years in technical consulting, solution architecture, or delivery leadership within enterprise software, consulting firms, or system integrators. At least 3 years in a senior or lead technical role with multi-stakeholder responsibility in large-scale projects at tier-1 organizations (e.g. digital twin implementations, global AI transformations, near-real-time data pipelines, etc.) 
  • Architecture skills: Proven ability to design complex, multi-component solutions that span data integration, process intelligence, automation, and AI, while remaining grounded in the “so-what” of a customer’s process. Deep understanding of enterprise architecture patterns and trade-offs.
  • Platform mastery: Expert-level knowledge of the Celonis platform, including the Process Intelligence Graph, data modeling, advanced PQL, automation and orchestration engine, and AI modules. Ability to push the platform’s boundaries via a working knowledge of Python.
  • AI & agent orchestration: Demonstrated ability to design AI-augmented delivery workflows leveraging frontier tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Experience with context engineering, multi-agent system design, or AI validation at scale. Ability to define how AI should be used, not just use it.
  • Domain expertise: Deep knowledge in at least one major process domain or industry vertical. Ability to translate domain expertise into scalable solution patterns and credible customer advisory.
  • Customer executive presence: Track record of building trusted advisor relationships with VP and C-level stakeholders. Ability to present transformation strategies, defend architectural decisions, and navigate complex organizational dynamics. Demonstrated experience navigating complex IT landscapes and communicating technical trade-offs to senior leadership.
  • Consulting & communication: Exceptional ability to translate between technical and business audiences. Experience leading workshops, design sessions, and strategic reviews with senior stakeholders.
  • Leadership & mentoring: Demonstrated ability to raise the performance of teams around you. Experience mentoring technical staff, setting quality standards, and contributing to organizational capability development.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Technology Management, Business Informatics, or a comparable field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English and German required. 

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.

  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

description:
Localization Operations Specialist (Contractor)

Level: Mid-level contractor
Team: Localization
Location: London / Remote or Hybrid

The role

OpenTable’s Localization team helps make our products, content and customer experiences work naturally across global markets. As a Localization Operations Specialist, you will support the daily localization operation end to end, making sure content moves smoothly from intake to delivery, issues are resolved quickly and workflows continue to improve as we scale internationally.

 

This is a hands-on generalist role for someone who can move comfortably between project coordination, localization technology, integrations, strings management and troubleshooting. You will work with Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, CRM, Support, external language partners and other teams across OpenTable.

 

You will:

 

  • Manage localization requests from scoping and preparation through translation, review, QA and delivery.
  • Coordinate priorities, deadlines, dependencies, stakeholders and external language resources.
  • Operate and improve localization workflows across tools and integrations, including systems such as Figma, Braze and similar platforms.
  • Investigate issues such as missing strings, failed syncs, incorrect statuses, formatting problems, placeholders and duplicate content.
  • Work with product strings, keys, resource files, locales, branches, versions and context.
  • Support AI-enabled localization workflows, including AI translation, content generation, post-editing, quality checks and automation.
  • Identify recurring problems and turn them into better documentation, templates, automation or processes.

Qualifications

  • Experience in localization operations, localization project coordination, translation technology or content operations.
  • Practical understanding of the localization lifecycle from source preparation through delivery and QA.
  • Experience using a translation management system, localization platform or related content workflow tools.
  • Working knowledge of product strings and localization concepts such as keys, placeholders, resource files, locales, branches and versions.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, stakeholders and deadlines in a fast-moving environment.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate unclear or technical issues.
  • Comfortable working with integrations, connectors, APIs, imports/exports or system-to-system handoffs.
  • Clear communication skills and strong attention to detail.
  • A proactive, curious and solution-oriented mindset; you look for ways to make work simpler, faster and more reliable.
  • Comfortable working with evolving processes, new tools and changing priorities.

Plus to have

  • Experience with Phrase or another modern translation management platform.
  • Hands-on experience with Figma, Braze, GitHub, Jira, CMS platforms or customer communication systems.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, AI translation, machine translation post-editing, quality estimation, prompt design or AI features in localization tools.
  • Basic technical fluency with JSON, CSV, XML, HTML, resource files or API documentation.
  • Experience supporting product, UX, marketing, CRM, support, SEO or multimedia localization.
  • Experience working with language service providers, linguists or vendor delivery teams.
  • Familiarity with internationalization topics such as pluralization, text expansion, date and number formats, currencies and locale-specific requirements.
  • Experience using spreadsheets, dashboards or reporting to monitor localization performance.

This role is a strong fit for a localization “jack of all trades”: someone operationally dependable, technically curious, comfortable getting into the detail and relentless about finding a workable solution.   • Lead FortiGate policy architecture (zones, NAT, segmentation, IDS/IPS) and FortiGate VPN (IPsec/SSL) for site‑to‑site and remote access, including HA and posture checks.

  • Centralize logging with rsyslog and FortiAnalyzer; enforce retention and integrity for audits.
  • Use NetBox, Ansible/Python, and Git‑based workflows for configuration management, drift control, and repeatable changes.

6) Compliance, Risk & Vendor Management (TISAX Focus)

  • Map network controls to TISAX expectations (ISMS governance, secure remote access, logging, supplier access, data protection).
  • Partner with ISMS owner/CISO on risk assessments, controls testing, and evidence preparation for audits (policies, diagrams, logs, change records).

Role Overview As a pivotal leader within our European technical sales team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci's platform among the region's top engineering organizations. By acting as trusted technical advisors, you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition, showcasing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and accelerated time-to-market. Leveraging strong fundamentals in thermal physics and cooling strategies, you will guide analyses of complex thermal management systems, fluid flow dynamics, and heat dissipation challenges, including both steady-state and transient thermal behavior. Your team will help customers evaluate critical factors such as thermal risk, component reliability, power density, and cooling efficiency to architect cutting-edge thermal management systems for next-generation hardware. You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci's capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team. Responsibilities Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermal engineers, setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe. Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers. Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci's technical and business value. Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline, and account expansion, providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting. Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks, and partner directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features. Industry domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems. Customer engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships. Automation & scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data. Leadership impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams. Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives. Preferred (Desirable Differentiators) Multiphysics breadth: Familiarity with structural mechanical simulations (FEA/stress) and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows. Commercial track record: Direct experience commercializing technical software, ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools, into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises. Go-to-market experience: Prior experience within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments. Emerging tech adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools. Why Join Us Don't just use AI; help redefine how next-generation hardware is designed. Work at the convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise engineering. Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment. À propos de Vinci Vinci développe une IA fondée sur la physique (Physics AI) pour la conception de systèmes hardware. Notre plateforme donne aux équipes de conception et de simulation des prédictions physiques précises, obtenues en une fraction du temps d'une simulation classique, et qui s'intègrent à leurs outils existants. C'est la première solution à offrir à la fois la rigueur de la simulation traditionnelle et la vitesse de l'IA. Elle transforme la façon dont les semi-conducteurs les plus avancés au monde sont conçus, vérifiés et mis en production. Présentation du poste En tant que membre clé de notre équipe européenne de Forward Deployment, vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans l’adoption de la plateforme Vinci par les principales organisations d’ingénierie de la région. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous constituerez, accompagnerez et dirigerez une équipe performante de spécialistes en ingénierie thermique, chargée d’accompagner nos clients et prospects et de démontrer concrètement la valeur de notre logiciel. En tant que référent technique de confiance auprès de nos clients, vous et votre équipe mettrez à profit votre expertise approfondie en simulation pour aider nos clients industriels à valider et optimiser des conceptions complexes dans des conditions représentatives de leurs applications réelles. À travers ces collaborations, vous démontrerez comment la plateforme Vinci permet d’améliorer les performances thermiques et la fiabilité des produits, tout en accélérant les cycles de conception et la mise sur le marché. Grâce à votre solide maîtrise de la physique thermique et des stratégies de refroidissement, vous guiderez l’analyse de systèmes complexes de gestion thermique, notamment les phénomènes de transfert de chaleur, d’écoulement des fluides et de dissipation thermique, en régime permanent comme transitoire. Votre équipe aidera les clients à évaluer des paramètres critiques tels que les risques thermiques, la fiabilité des composants, la densité de puissance et l’efficacité des solutions de refroidissement, afin de concevoir des systèmes de gestion thermique performants pour les équipements de nouvelle génération. Vous jouerez également un rôle essentiel d’interface entre les clients et nos équipes Product et Engineering, en transformant les retours du terrain en informations exploitables pour orienter la feuille de route produit et contribuer à l’amélioration continue de la plateforme. Ce poste est basé en France et exercé en télétravail, avec une collaboration étroite avec les équipes Sales, Product et Engineering basées à Palo Alto, en Californie. Il implique des déplacements réguliers mais modérés, principalement en Europe continentale, ainsi que des déplacements occasionnels aux États-Unis pour collaborer avec l’équipe américaine Responsabilités Construire, diriger et développer une équipe performante d’ingénieur·es thermiques, en définissant l’orientation technique, en recrutant et accompagnant les membres de l’équipe, et en pilotant l’exécution sur le terrain à travers l’Europe. Fournir des orientations et des retours sur le produit, identifier les difficultés rencontrées par les clients et les points de friction dans leurs workflows, et collaborer directement avec les équipes Produit et Engineering internes afin de transformer les retours du terrain en fonctionnalités produit clés. Représenter Vinci lors de grandes conférences industrielles et d’événements dédiés aux semi-conducteurs, en échangeant avec des prospects et partenaires stratégiques à travers des présentations techniques et des démonstrations en direct de la plateforme. Qualifications (Qualifications minimales) Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent (Master, doctorat) en génie mécanique, génie électrique ou dans un domaine technique étroitement lié. Domaine industriel : Solide connaissance des technologies de packaging électronique pour les semi-conducteurs, des technologies de packaging avancé (par exemple, IC 2.5D/3D) ou des écosystèmes de fonderies. Profil recherché (Atouts différenciants) Expertise multiphysique : Connaissance du calcul de structures (FEA/contraintes) et/ou des flux de travail Signal Integrity et Power Integrity (SI/PI). Travaillez à la convergence de modèles d'IA de pointe, de la physique fondamentale et de projets industriels à forts enjeux. Collaborez avec des équipes d'ingénierie et de recherche de renommée mondiale, dans un environnement de start-up en forte croissance.   • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Minerva software team develops our overarching command, control, and edge autonomy software across multiple domain platforms and handheld ground stations. We are a geographically distributed, multi-disciplinary engineering group bridging high-level decision-making software with physical vehicle control and sensor payloads. In this role, you will work within the Minerva product organisation and report directly to the Lead Product Manager to ensure seamless cross-platform functionality and multi-sensor integration across all operational deployments.

YOUR MISSION

You will support the product strategy for integrating our core Minerva software architecture—spanning C2 systems to Edge stacks—across diverse uncrewed platforms and sensor payloads. Reporting directly to the Lead Product Manager, you will translate complex multi-domain operational requirements and hardware constraints into structured, actionable engineering roadmaps. Success looks like unified cross-platform releases, advanced AI capabilities delivered on edge assets, robust sensor integration cycles, and reliable platform software performance across all deployment domains.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Specify Concepts of Operation, system and subsystem product requirements, and acceptance criteria 
  • Incorporate customer requirements, operator and customer feedback, and the wider STARK product vision into scalable Minerva versions across different uncrewed platforms and handheld control systems
  • Establish metrics and acceptance criteria for cross-platform software stability, data latency, and sensor fusion reliability
  • Define expectations and priorities for AI systems running within edge constraints 
  • Collaborate closely with Lead Product Manager, Product Owners and Technical Product Managers, and Engineering Leads to evaluate technical trade-offs across edge computing and C2 capabilities
  • Collaborate with system engineers and hardware teams across different hardware platforms to ensure Minerva edge software delivers maximum performance
  • Work directly with engineering leads and product colleagues to track sprint progress and remove blockers
  • Support integration compliance with military communication standards and protocols (e.g., SAPIENT, TAK, SitaWare)
  • Ensure the Minerva stack and development processes respect industry audit requirements (e.g. AQAP) 
  • Anticipate tests and validations and collaborate with IV&V, Product Safety, InfoSec, Configuration Management colleagues to ensure fast release turnarounds without compromising on safety and security  

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • 3+ years of technical product management or product ownership experience software-heavy or complex systems environment
  • Demonstrated experience supporting complex software integration projects across hardware devices, sensors, or edge computing stacks
  • Strong technical literacy in software architecture, APIs, and data integration patterns
  • Experience with foundational AI systems (e.g. in computer vision, localisation) 
  • Proven track record of defining product specifications, backlog grooming, and user stories for agile engineering teams
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to bridge hardware, software, and operational perspectives
  • Fluent English verbal and written communication skills

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with defence tech, C2 systems, robotics, or autonomous unmanned vehicles
  • Familiarity with sensor integration (Radar, EO/IR, LiDAR) and defence protocols (TAK, SAPIENT)
  • Experience with software products designed for degraded or offline tactical network conditions
  • Experience with hardware/software integrations

description: Wanna join the adventure? At Loft, we are convinced that space programs should not have to be rebuilt from scratch every time. Our philosophy has been to productize them: we develop our own proprietary technology blocks, hardware and software, so that a customer payload can be integrated faster and more reliably than any bespoke program allows. That approach has delivered — it is why our customers reach orbit in months rather than years, and it is what makes working here different from working in the rest of the industry. We are now taking the next step: launching and operating our own constellations, and building a new set of services on top of them. That includes a full product suite enabling third-party AI applications to run directly onboard our satellites, and a growing ecosystem of partners whose needs we have to understand and design for. Loft is expanding at a very high pace, and the range of what we build is expanding just as fast. This is why Product Management matters so much here. Someone has to hold the whole picture — what is technically possible, what customers actually need, what we should build first — and turn it into something engineering and leadership can act on. As a Product Manager, you will own a significant perimeter and the autonomy that goes with it. We are growing the team precisely so that each of us can go deeper on our topics, anticipate rather than react, and have more impact across the company. You will need to be comfortable talking to anyone here. In the same week you might sit with a system engineer to understand a design constraint, join a BD call with an institutional customer, and present a recommendation to the executive team. Ideas at Loft get discussed openly and on their merits, wherever they come from, so being able to ask a naive question without ego — and to disagree with someone senior without making it personal — matters more than seniority. About this role: Understand what is possible, and turn it into requirements Spend the bulk of your time with engineering: understanding architectures, constraints, and dependencies well enough to judge what is realistically doable in a given timeframe. Translate strategic direction into clear requirements and use cases that engineering can act on directly, and follow them down to the Jira tickets. Surface and shape the good ideas that come from engineering — many of the best ones do — and connect them to a product rationale. Define success criteria for each capability, and verify they are actually met through implementation and delivery. Maintain an accurate, shared view of Loft's product capabilities, what is in development, and where the gaps are. Bring the outside in Run customer discovery interviews alongside business development, and debrief missions to see how Loft's capabilities are actually used in operations. Engage directly with the partners building on our platform, including the onboard AI application ecosystem, to understand their needs and constraints. Track market trends and competitive moves closely enough to know where our offering stands. Decide and prioritize Own the roadmap for your perimeter, reconciling customer needs, engineering reality, and Loft's strategy into a single coherent plan. Build the analysis behind every recommendation — sizing, segmentation, business cases, operational data — so decisions are grounded in evidence rather than intuition alone. Negotiate scope and delivery commitments with engineering leadership, and re-plan when capacity or mission timelines shift. Challenge, constructively and with data, business development, engineering leadership, and your own assumptions. Communicate Own internal communication on your perimeter: keep engineering, program leadership, and executives working from the same technical reality. Develop the technical narratives and proof points that marketing and BD then turn into their own customer-facing material. Prepare recommendations and presentations for top-executive-level audiences. Must Haves: 7+ years of professional experience, including hands-on product management. Domain experience in at least one of: earth observation, embedded systems, aerospace systems, security & defense. Comfort at both ends of the spectrum — understand the market, and the technology Structured and data-driven: you bring your experience and your intuitions, but when you put a recommendation on the table you can show the analysis it stands on. Real product obsession: you think about the bigger picture and product-market fit before you think about features. Relentless curiosity. In a single month you might move from a satellite bus constraint, to onboard AI inference, to a defense accreditation requirement — and you need to find that stimulating rather than exhausting. High autonomy and a bias for action: handed a broad perimeter, you organize it yourself and come back with a plan. At ease being challenged, and challenging others, in a fast-moving and demanding environment. Working knowledge of both hardware and software development lifecycles. Proficient using and configuring Atlassian tools (Jira and Confluence). Fluency in English, written and spoken. Willingness to travel to other Loft offices and to customers. Nice to Haves: Fluency in French. Experience with AI/ML products, edge computing, or developer and partner platforms and ecosystems. Experience with satellite operations, constellation services, or ground segment products. Exposure to institutional and defense customers and their procurement cycles. Experience in a fast-growing, entrepreneurial NewSpace company or venture-backed deep-tech startup. Professional experience working with international teams across time zones. Some of Our Awesome Benefits: Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best Health and life insurance, we care about your health Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand) Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes. Who We Are Loft: Space Made Simple. Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit. We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives. With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure. description: Wil jij bouwen aan de woningbouwopgave én aan een nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie? Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar bij Dura Vermeer Bouw & Vastgoed werk je aan grootschalige woningbouwprojecten in Midden-Nederland. Je stapt in na tendergunning en bent verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling richting realisatie. In een ondernemende omgeving krijg je alle ruimte om mee te bouwen aan het team, je expertise in te zetten in de samenwerking met bouwpartners én door te groeien naar een rol met meer inhoudelijke en coachende verantwoordelijkheid. Dit wordt jouw baan Ondernemend, ervaren en klaar om impact te maken? Dan voel jij je thuis binnen deze nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie van Dura Vermeer. Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar werk je aan omvangrijke woningbouwontwikkelingen en help je niet alleen projecten verder te brengen, maar ook het team en de organisatie. Je begrijpt hoe ontwikkeling en bouw elkaar versterken, neemt eigenaarschap en krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken, mee te bouwen en mee te groeien. Je bent betrokken vanaf de fase na tendergunning en schakelt intensief met de bouw om projecten succesvol richting uitvoering te brengen. Daarnaast krijg je de mogelijkheid om in de toekomst ontwikkelaars te begeleiden en bijvoorbeeld door te groeien naar een rol als Hoofd Vastgoedontwikkeling. Wat ga je doen Deze functie richt zich nadrukkelijk niet op de initiatieffase of acquisitiekant van gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling. De focus ligt op het moment waarop een tender is gewonnen en projecten daadwerkelijk gerealiseerd gaan worden. Je werkt aan (midel)grote woningbouwontwikkelingen van honderden woningen en bent de verbindende factor tussen ontwikkeling en bouw. Dat maakt deze rol ideaal voor een ervaren ontwikkelaar die energie krijgt van het realiseren van projecten, ondernemerschap toont en wil meegroeien met een ambitieuze organisatie. · Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van woningbouwprojecten vanaf tendergunning tot aan de start van de realisatie; · Je stuurt het ontwikkelproces aan op het gebied van kwaliteit, planning, financiën en risico's; · Je verbindt de belangen van gemeenten, adviseurs, beleggers, corporaties, bouwteams en andere stakeholders; · Je werkt intensief samen met collega's van Bouw om projecten optimaal uitvoerbaar en haalbaar te maken; · Je vertaalt ambities en plannen naar concrete ontwikkelbeslissingen die bijdragen aan een succesvolle uitvoering; · Je voert regie op vergunningstrajecten, overeenkomsten en besluitvorming; · Je bewaakt de businesscase en stuurt op waardecreatie gedurende het gehele ontwikkelproces; · Je draagt actief bij aan de verdere opbouw en professionalisering van de ontwikkelorganisatie; · Je begeleidt en coacht minder ervaren projectontwikkelaars en krijgt de ruimte om op termijn een meer aansturende rol te vervullen. Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent iconisch én dichtbij en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Hier zit je op jouw plek Bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Utrecht staan we aan het begin van een nieuw hoofdstuk. Waar we jarenlang bekend stonden als een sterke renovatie/transformatiespecialist, zijn we sinds begin dit jaar uitgegroeid tot een volwaardige Bouw en Vastgoed organisatie. Naast renovatie en transformatie realiseren we nu ook nieuwbouwprojecten in de woning- en utiliteitsbouw én zetten we de volgende stap naar eigen gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling. description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:  

The Director of Sales, Europe will be responsible for leading our regional sales organization, driving Planet’s Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy, and accelerating revenue growth across national security, defense, and government sectors.

As a people manager and business leader, you will own the regional revenue target, drive executive alignment, and establish disciplined pipeline governance to ensure forecast predictability. You will be responsible for building, mentoring, and coaching a team of direct reports—fostering a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous professional development. In addition to team development, you will architect large-scale strategic programs, lead high-stakes commercial negotiations, and scale partner ecosystems to penetrate priority markets. Above all, you will leverage your leadership experience to elevate Planet’s market presence across NATO and the Nordics in alignment with our mission to see change and change the world.

The ideal candidate is an accomplished sales leader with deep defense domain expertise and a track record of managing high-performing teams across Alliance structures and Northern European markets. You will bring an established executive network spanning NATO HQ, allied Defense Ministries, Armed Forces Commands, Intelligence Agencies, and key European Prime Contractors/System Integrators. Combining strategic commercial acumen with an understanding of collective defense and national security priorities, you will position Planet as a trusted capability provider for mission-critical operations.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United Kingdom or Germany. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Drive Strategic Revenue Growth: Own and execute a result-oriented Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy to build, negotiate, and close high-value, complex deals across sovereign defense and government sectors, consistently hitting or exceeding regional quota targets.

  • Deal Cadence & Executive Escalation: Communicate deal velocity transparently across internal business units, mobilizing executive sponsorship and cross-functional support when needed to de-risk complex pursuits.

What You Bring:

  • 8+ years of relevant work experience and 6+ years supervisory / leadership experience, with a track record of driving revenue growth, building high-performing teams, and consistently exceeding multi-million-dollar individual and team quotas.
  • Ability to recruit, mentor, and retain top-tier talent, instilling a high-accountability culture and coaching direct reports through complex, multi-year deal cycles.

  • An established, C-level network across Defense Ministries, Intelligence Agencies, Allied Commands, and European Defense Primes / System Integrators.
  • Deep understanding of how commercial technology and advanced data feeds support Allied posture, sovereign defense, intelligence, and ISR missions.
  • Success collaborating across internal matrixed teams (Government Affairs, Product, Engineering, Legal) to align corporate capabilities with regional opportunities.
  • A strategic, self-directed leader with commercial judgment, adept at leading teams through dynamic, high-growth, or startup-like market environments.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • 5+ years of progressive sales leadership and enterprise business development experience within the defense, national security, or government technology sectors, with a track record of building high-performing teams and consistently exceeding revenue targets.
  • Operational understanding of NATO defense priorities, Nordic security dynamics, joint acquisition processes, and agency decision-making across Allied Ministries of Defense and Tier-1 Defense Primes.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-year deal cycles, with the ability to lead sales teams through disciplined capture frameworks, pipeline governance, and accurate revenue forecasting.
  • Professional proficiency in a Nordic language (Swedish, Finnish, Norwegian, Danish) is a plus for engaging senior government ministers, military command leadership, and internal executives.

About Upsun

Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It’s built for hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and people focus on the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale with confidence, without wrestling with backend infrastructure.

Upsun Dispatch, our newest offering, brings that same idea to the whole team. It’s the platform for governed collaboration between AI agents and cross-functional humans. Agents handle the volume in isolated sandboxes. People make the decisions that matter, with every approval and every cost on the record.

We give you your time back. You get:

  • Predictable performance, even at scale
  • Secure, compliant environments by default
  • Real-time observability and profiling built in
  • Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds
  • AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack

The name says it all. “Up” stands for uptime, reliability, and acceleration. “Sun” reflects our follow-the-sun support: a 24x7, globally distributed team keeping the lights on while you rest. We believe software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.

Upsunners are a remote, global team, and we thrive in a multicultural one. We’re committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment, and our people span the whole experience spectrum. What ties us together is curiosity, a thirst for knowledge, and an eagerness for new ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together when the environment frees you to do your best work.

Our values:
🌿 We make a positive impact.
✨ We aim for the stars.
💚 We care for each other.

Impact of a Director, Product-Led Growth

As Director, PLG, you’ll lead the strategy, execution, and commercial success of Upsun’s product-led revenue engine. Upsun is expanding its portfolio with Upsun Dispatch, a strategic new offer that joins Upsun Cloud, and this role will turn that expansion into measurable growth. 

Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer, you will own the revenue target for product-led experiences, building a scalable engine across developer recruitment, freemium conversion, and customer retention. Working at the intersection of Marketing, Product Management, and Engineering, you will bridge technical platform capabilities with market-driven execution to scale Upsun’s global footprint. 

What to expect

  • Own product-led revenue: Be accountable for ARR from self-serve experiences, from first signup through conversion, expansion, and retention. 

  • Drive growth goals: Build and execute PLG programs to achieve clear top-line ARR milestones and hit aggressive user acquisition targets with specific focus in Europe and North America.  

  • Connect growth and product: Partner closely with the Head of Growth (Marketing), Head of User Acquisition and Conversion (Marketing)  and Upsun Dispatch Product Managers (Product/Engineering) to translate product strategy into measurable customer and business outcomes.  

  • Optimize the funnel: Define in-product monetization levers, optimize self-service funnels, and partner with Sales to refine Product-Led Sales (PLS) handoffs for enterprise accounts.  

  • Build tight feedback loops: Analyze intent data, user behavior, and churn metrics to continuously iterate on user onboarding, NPS, and lifetime value.  

What you bring

  • PLG and growth leadership: A track record as a Senior Product Manager or Director with growth and commercial revenue responsibilities at a developer-focused, SaaS, or cloud platform company driven primarily by a PLG model.  

  • Strategic judgment: Ability to turn complex developer platform capabilities into intuitive self-service user experiences that drive clear, measurable business value.  

  • Cross-functional execution: A record of leading cross-functional growth initiatives across Marketing, Product Management, and Engineering.

  • Data-driven approach: Hands-on depth in growth analytics, conversion funnels, freemium-to-paid activation, and retention.

  • Developer and AI fluency: Practical understanding of modern developer workflows, cloud infrastructure, and how AI-assisted development tools are reshaping user expectations.  

Bonus points

  • Dual-funnel experience: Running both self-serve funnels (PLG) and enterprise sales handoffs (PLS).

  • Platform background: Cloud infrastructure, PaaS, DevOps, or developer platforms.

  • Global scale: Scaling product-led revenue across remote-first, international teams.

Where we hire

At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in Canada, France, Germany, Spain, the United Kingdom, and the United States. Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries. 

How we hire

We know that a great hire won’t meet every requirement that we’ve outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance.   

You can expect 5 interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you’re looking for in your future working environment. 

  1. 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition 
  2. 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Chief Marketing Officer)

  4. 60 Minutes with Team (Head of Growth)
  5. 45 Minutes with Executive (CFO)

All roles require background checks.

🌎 A global team - Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives

🩺 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain, USA)

📈 Company stock options

🧠 Professional development budget

💻 Office equipment budget

💆‍♀️ Wellness budget

🧳 Annual team gatherings

👶 Inclusive parental leave

✈️ Remote work travel program

You belong here

At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. About the Role 

Veeam is seeking a technically strong, customer-focused Strategic Partner Solutions Architect – Securiti.ai to accelerate Securiti.ai business through the established Veeam partner ecosystem. This individual will serve as the trusted technical advisor to Veeam partners, working closely with Veeam’s Channel Managers, Strategic Partner Specialists and Systems Engineers to design, demonstrate and validate Securiti.ai solutions for partners and their customers. This position adds deep technical expertise to the partner motion while preserving the Channel Manager’s ownership of the overall partner relationship. 

The Solutions Architect will bring hands-on expertise in Data Security, DSPM, AI Security, AI Governance, Privacy and GRC. Together with Veeam channel and partner teams, this individual will build partner technical capability, lead solution design and proofs of value, and help convert partner-led opportunities into measurable Securiti.ai pipeline and revenue. 

 Success requires technical depth, strong collaboration and the ability to translate complex data security and AI governance requirements into clear, deployable solutions. The ideal candidate is a credible pre-sales architect who excels in an overlay model — someone who strengthens existing Veeam partner relationships while contributing the architecture, demonstrations and enablement needed to build a successful Securiti.ai practice. This person can earn the confidence of partner engineers and customer security leaders alike and turn technical engagement into repeatable, partner-delivered outcomes. 

 What You’ll Do 

 Veeam Channel and Technical Alignment 

Operate as the technical overlay within the Veeam channel organization: 

  • Partner with Veeam Channel Managers, Strategic Partner Specialists and Systems Engineers to support each assigned partner with a consistent technical engagement cadence. 
  • Own the Securiti.ai technical strategy, solution architecture and pre-sales motion within each partner relationship, while the Veeam Channel Manager retains ownership of the overall relationship. 
  • Jointly engage partner technical leaders with Veeam teams to align on priority use cases, solution roadmaps and technical investments. 
  • Equip Veeam Systems Engineers and Channel Managers with the technical messaging, demo assets and training needed to introduce Securiti.ai into partner and customer conversations. 
  • Set clear rules of engagement for technical support, opportunity handoffs and escalations so partners experience Veeam and Securiti.ai as one team. 
  • Serve as the bridge between partners and Veeam and Securiti.ai product management, engineering, support and services teams, relaying field feedback and feature requirements. 

 Partner Technical Planning 

  • Develop technical enablement and certification plans for assigned partners alongside their Veeam Channel Managers and Partner Specialists, setting goals for certified engineers, demo capability, proofs of value and delivery readiness. 
  • Assess partner technical maturity, including security expertise, cloud and platform skills, services capacity and integration capabilities. 
  • Incorporate Securiti.ai technical priorities into existing Veeam partner plans and quarterly business reviews. 
  • Identify the lab, demo, training and technical resources each partner requires and review readiness on a regular cadence with Veeam and partner stakeholders. 

 Solution Architecture and Practice Enablement 

  • Recruit, train and certify partner solution engineers, architects and services teams on Securiti.ai. 
  • Lead the technical build-out of partner Data Security, DSPM and AI Governance practices, defining reference architectures, delivery methodologies, skills and certification paths. 
  • Deliver technical training, workshops and hands-on labs that enable partner and Veeam teams to demonstrate and position Securiti.ai Data Security, DSPM, AI Security, AI Governance, Privacy and GRC capabilities. 
  • Help partners design repeatable technical assessments, workshops, managed services and implementation offerings. 
  • Architect joint solutions that integrate Securiti.ai with the partner’s own services and their existing Veeam portfolio, creating differentiated, repeatable solutions for their customers. 
  • Create and maintain technical assets, including demo environments, reference architectures, solution briefs, discovery guides and competitive technical positioning. 

 Pre-Sales and Opportunity Support 

  • Lead technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations and proofs of value with partners for priority customer opportunities. 
  • Align Veeam, Securiti.ai and partner technical teams around priority customers, supporting opportunities from technical qualification through close. 
  • Respond to technical requirements, RFPs and security questionnaires, and address architecture, integration and compliance questions from customer stakeholders. 
  • Support a smooth transition from sale to implementation, ensuring partner delivery teams are prepared for successful deployment and adoption. 

 Measures of Success 

  • Securiti.ai pipeline and revenue influenced through partner technical engagement. 
  • Number of partner engineers trained and certified on Securiti.ai and partners able to independently demonstrate, sell and deliver solutions. 
  • Technical win rate and conversion of proofs of value into closed business. 
  • Number of joint solutions, reference architectures and partner-led assessments and services brought to market. 
  • Customer deployment success, partner satisfaction and strength of alignment with Veeam channel and technical teams. 

 

What You’ll Bring 

  •  7+ years of experience in pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, sales engineering or technical consulting for enterprise technology. 
  • Demonstrated success in a channel-facing, partner technical or overlay pre-sales role. 
  • Proven ability to collaborate with existing account and relationship owners while leading the technical sale for a specialized solution portfolio. 
  • Experience enabling and supporting technical teams at VARs, solution providers, MSPs, integrators, or advisory partners. 
  • Strong ability to lead technical discovery, solution design, product demonstrations and proofs of value. 
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, data security, data governance, privacy or AI security. 
  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), SaaS applications, data platforms and identity and access management. 
  • Ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes, architectures and use cases that both sales and technical audiences can act on. 
  • Ability to influence internal and external stakeholders without relying on direct authority. 
  • Strong communication, presentation, whiteboarding and technical writing skills. 
  • Ability to manage multiple partner and customer engagements while maintaining accountability for measurable results. 
  • Willingness to travel for partner meetings, enablement sessions, customer engagements and industry events. 

 Bonus Skills 

  • Hands-on experience with Securiti.ai or comparable DSPM, data discovery and classification, AI governance, privacy management, or GRC platforms. 
  • Experience designing partner-led assessments, managed services, workshops, or professional services offerings. 
  • Familiarity with privacy and AI regulations and frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF. 
  • Relevant security, privacy, or cloud certifications (for example CIPP, CISSP, CCSP, or an AWS, Azure or GCP architect or security credential). 

What You'll Get

Veeam, following its acquisition of Securiti AI - the leader in AI-powered data security posture management (DSPM) - is seeking Business Development Representatives to drive growth in this innovative business. 

You will generate new demand and build qualified pipeline, working both self-generated outbound and inbound demand from marketing. You will run discovery conversations that produce genuinely qualified opportunities, and stay with them until they are established with a Sales Specialist. 

What You’ll Do

Generate demand 

  • Work inbound and marketing-sourced leads — demo requests, event leads and campaign responses.

  • Give marketing structured feedback on lead quality, events and campaigns. You see first-hand what converts and what does not, and that insight should shape where the next investment goes. 

Keep the record straight 

  • Log every meeting outcome within 24 hours and link each opportunity to the meeting that originated it.
  • Maintain accurate records of account activity and qualification in Salesforce — reporting and forecasting depend on it. 

Grow

  • Stay current on industry trends and the competitive landscape, and seek feedback to keep improving

What You’ll Bring

description: Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties Ben jij een ervaren installatietechnicus die klaar is voor een leidinggevende rol? Of geef je al leiding aan monteurs en wil je meer verantwoordelijkheid binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek? Dan hebben we bij Campus Installatietechniek in Barneveld een mooie uitdaging voor je! Als Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties combineer je jouw technische kennis met het aansturen en begeleiden van een team monteurs. Je zorgt dat werkzaamheden goed worden voorbereid, projecten volgens planning verlopen en jouw collega's hun werk optimaal kunnen uitvoeren. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen de monteurs, werkvoorbereiding, projectleiding en opdrachtgevers. Daarbij houd je overzicht, denk je mee over technische oplossingen en zorg je voor een prettige samenwerking. Wat we je bieden Bij Campus Installatietechniek krijg je de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, jouw team verder te ontwikkelen en mee te bouwen aan mooie installatieprojecten. Daar staat natuurlijk iets tegenover: Een goed salaris dat past bij jouw kennis, ervaring en verantwoordelijkheden; Een afwisselende functie voor 32 tot 40 uur per week; Veel zelfstandigheid en vrijheid om jouw werkzaamheden te organiseren; Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden; Afwisselende projecten binnen de utiliteitsbouw en gebouwgebonden installatietechniek; Opleidingen, cursussen en doorgroeimogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen; Moderne middelen en gereedschappen om je werk goed uit te voeren; Een informele werksfeer met betrokken collega's en korte communicatielijnen; De voordelen en ontwikkelmogelijkheden van de VDK Groep, gecombineerd met de persoonlijke sfeer van Campus. Wat je gaat doen Als Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en coördinatie van werkzaamheden binnen verschillende installatieprojecten. Je zorgt dat jouw team weet wat er moet gebeuren en dat projecten veilig, efficiënt en volgens afspraak worden uitgevoerd. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren van monteurs en technici; Coördineren en verdelen van werkzaamheden binnen werktuigbouwkundige installatieprojecten; Bewaken van de planning, voortgang, kwaliteit, veiligheid en kosten; Afstemmen met projectleiders, werkvoorbereiders, opdrachtgevers en leveranciers; Zorgen dat materialen, informatie en middelen tijdig beschikbaar zijn; Meedenken over technische vraagstukken rondom klimaatinstallaties, verwarming en luchtbehandeling; Signaleren van verbeterkansen en bijdragen aan efficiëntere werkprocessen; Onderhouden van goede contacten met klanten en andere betrokken partijen. Je staat dicht bij de techniek, maar houdt tegelijkertijd het overzicht over het grotere geheel. Dankzij jouw inzet kunnen de monteurs hun werk goed uitvoeren en worden projecten succesvol opgeleverd. Wat neem je mee? Je hebt een stevige technische basis binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek en vindt het leuk om collega's aan te sturen en verder te helpen. Je kunt goed organiseren, communiceert duidelijk en weet ook bij onverwachte situaties het overzicht te bewaren. Daarnaast herken jij jezelf in het volgende: Een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-opleiding richting installatietechniek, werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar; Enkele jaren werkervaring binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek, bijvoorbeeld als Eerste Monteur, Leidinggevend Monteur of Teamleider; Kennis van gebouwgebonden installaties, zoals verwarmingsinstallaties, klimaatinstallaties en luchtbehandeling; Leidinggevende kwaliteiten en het vermogen om collega's te motiveren; Organisatorisch inzicht en een goed gevoel voor planning en kwaliteit; Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een klantgerichte instelling; Een proactieve houding en het vermogen om technische en organisatorische uitdagingen op te lossen. Heb je ruime ervaring als Eerste Monteur of Leidinggevend Monteur en ben je toe aan een volgende stap? Ook dan komen we graag met je in contact! Waar ga je het doen? Campus Installatietechniek is een installatiebedrijf gevestigd in Barneveld. We werken aan uiteenlopende werktuigbouwkundige installaties binnen de utiliteit en gebouwgebonden installatietechniek.Bij Campus houden we van korte lijnen, duidelijke afspraken en een praktische aanpak. We zorgen voor een goede voorbereiding en ondersteunen elkaar waar nodig. Hierdoor kunnen onze monteurs zich richten op hun vak en kunnen projecten efficiënt worden uitgevoerd. Als Teamleider krijg je de ruimte om mee te denken, verbeteringen door te voeren en jouw eigen stempel te drukken op de dagelijkse werkzaamheden. Je werkt samen met betrokken collega's die elkaar kennen, helpen en samen zorgen voor tevreden klanten. Wij zijn een trots onderdeel van de snelgroeiende VDK Groep (185 bedrijven, 9.000 collega’s), maar opereren met een eigen identiteit en cultuur. Dit betekent dat je bij ons de voordelen van een grote organisatie ervaart – denk aan opleidingsmogelijkheden, een stabiele basis en top secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden – terwijl je tegelijkertijd de vrijheid, dynamiek en verantwoordelijkheid krijgt om je eigen stempel te drukken bij het lokale bedrijf. Interesse? Zie jij jezelf al werken als Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties bij Campus Installatietechniek? Dan komen we graag met je in contact! Heb je vragen over de functie of wil je direct solliciteren? Neem gerust contact op met Didi Koers, Recruitment Business Partner bij de VDK Groep. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine. Après avoir digitalisé le secteur de la beauté dans plusieurs pays d'Europe, nous recherchons nos premiers commerciaux pour faire de la France une de nos plus grandes réussites. L'opportunité Rejoins notre équipe en tant que représentant(e) commercial(e) et deviens l'un des visages de la révolution digitale du secteur. Chez Salonkee, tu as l'opportunité unique de piloter des projets ambitieux, de collaborer avec des experts passionnés et de marquer de ton empreinte l'expansion d'une scale-up en plein essor. description: Werde Teil unseres Teams Apaleo ist die offene Hospitality-Plattform, die Hotels die Freiheit gibt, ihre Technologie so zusammenzustellen, wie sie sie wirklich brauchen. Wir waren von Anfang an API-first, und jetzt denken wir unsere Plattform AI-first weiter: Mit Agent Hub, dem ersten KI-Agenten-Marktplatz der Hotellerie, geben wir Hotels die Freiheit, autonome Agenten für ihr Business einzusetzen. Denselben Anspruch haben wir an unser eigenes Finance: Wir bauen es konsequent AI-native auf. Dafür suchen wir eine*n Senior Bilanzbuchhalter*in, die oder der fundiertes Buchhaltungs-Know-how mit echter Begeisterung für agentische Workflows verbindet und mit uns Strukturen, Prozesse und Kontrollen für ein skalierbares Finance aufbaut. Du übernimmst zunächst eigenverantwortlich das operative Tagesgeschäft in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem dreiköpfigen Finance-Team. Mittelfristig verschiebt sich dein Fokus vom Buchen zum Orchestrieren: KI-Agenten übernehmen Belegverarbeitung, Kontierung und Abstimmungen, du definierst die Regeln, überwachst die Ergebnisse und verantwortest Qualität und Compliance als Human in the Loop. Mittelfristig gestaltest du mit uns den Weg zu einem AI-native Accounting- und ERP-Setup und wirst zur zentralen Ansprechperson für alle buchhalterischen Fragen bei Apaleo. So bringst du dich ein: Du bearbeitest eigenverantwortlich sämtliche in der Finanzbuchhaltung anfallenden Geschäftsvorfälle (Rechnungskontrolle, Debitoren-, Kreditoren-, Anlagen-, Sachkonten- und Bankbuchhaltung) und stellst eine jederzeit prüfungssichere, GoBD-konforme Datenbasis für Reporting und Steuerung sicher. Du übernimmst zusammen mit unserem Team die Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB mit festen Deadlines und treibst einen schnelleren, zunehmend automatisierten Close (Fast Close) voran. Du konzipierst und implementierst agentische Workflows für wiederkehrende Prozesse wie Belegerfassung, Kontierung, Bankabstimmung, Rückstellungen und Intercompany und gestaltest damit, wie sich deine eigene Rolle über die Zeit entwickelt: weg vom manuellen Buchen, hin zum Orchestrieren, Überwachen und Freigeben der Arbeit von KI-Agenten. Du arbeitest eng mit externen Steuerberater*innen und Wirtschaftsprüfer*innen zusammen. Du gestaltest mit, wie sich unser Finance-Tech-Stack mittelfristig zu einem AI-native Accounting- und ERP-Setup entwickelt: von Tool-Auswahl und Datenmodell über saubere Stammdaten und Schnittstellen bis zu skalierbaren End-to-End-Prozessen, die mit uns mitwachsen. Du wirst über Zeit zur zentralen Ansprechperson für alle buchhalterischen Fragen bei Apaleo und bringst die Erfahrung und Übersicht mit, um Themen auch über dein eigenes Gebiet hinaus einzuordnen. Das bringst du mit: Must-haves Abgeschlossene Aus-/Weiterbildung zum/zur Bilanzbuchhalter*in (IHK) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation, mit mehrjähriger praktischer Erfahrung in der Finanzbuchhaltung. Sehr gute Kenntnisse im deutschen Handelsrecht (HGB); IFRS-Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Sehr gute DATEV- und Excel-Kenntnisse sowie ein ausgeprägtes Prozess- und Systemverständnis: Du denkst in Datenflüssen, nicht in Einzelbuchungen. Erfahrung mit Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen unter echtem Zeit- und Deadlinedruck im Unternehmen. Nahezu muttersprachliches Deutsch (für die Kommunikation mit Steuerberater*innen, Wirtschaftsprüfer*innen und Behörden sowie für statutarische Meldungen) und gutes Arbeitsenglisch (für die Zusammenarbeit mit Legal und weiteren internationalen Stakeholdern). Strukturierte, eigenständige und proaktive Arbeitsweise, du sprichst Unklarheiten direkt an, statt sie auflaufen zu lassen. Du bist mindestens zweimal pro Woche in unserem Büro in München, idealerweise wohnst du bereits in München oder im Umkreis. Du bist komfortabel mit Prozessambiguität und schnellem Wandel, triffst pragmatische 80/20-Entscheidungen und lieferst gleichzeitig hohe Qualität, wo es darauf ankommt. Echte Neugier auf KI: Du nutzt Tools wie ChatGPT oder Claude bereits im Arbeitsalltag, prüfst ihre Ergebnisse kritisch und willst Prozesse grundlegend neu denken, statt sie nur zu digitalisieren. Nice-to-haves Du hast bereits agentische Workflows oder Automatisierungen im Finanzbereich aufgesetzt (z. B. mit LLMs, RPA oder Tools wie n8n oder Make) und kannst konkret zeigen, wie sich dadurch Qualität, Durchlaufzeit und Close verbessert haben. Erfahrung in einem Software-/SaaS-Unternehmen oder einem wachstumsstarken Start-up/Scale-up; Vertrautheit mit SaaS-Kennzahlen. Erfahrung in einem Private-Equity-Umfeld. Berührungspunkte mit Verrechnungspreisthemen (Transfer Pricing). Vertrautheit mit Employer-of-Record-Strukturen (EOR) und ihren Das kannst du von uns erwarten: Ein vielfältiges und internationales Team – Arbeite mit engagierten Experten aus verschiedenen Fachbereichen und mit unterschiedlichem Hintergrund zusammen und entwickele eine wirklich globale Lösung. Flache Hierarchie und flexible Struktur – Genieße Autonomie und Eigenverantwortung in einem Umfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit mehr geschätzt wird als starre Hierarchien. Eine Schlüsselrolle in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen – Werde Teil eines der vielversprechendsten internationalen Software Unternehmens der Hotellerie im Herzen Münchens und gestalte den Finanzbereich aktiv mit. Faire und transparente Vergütung – Profitiere von einem klaren Peer-Review-System und einem Career Progression Plänen, der Ihr Wachstum unterstützen. Ein AI-native Arbeitsumfeld: Arbeite mit aktuellen KI-Tools und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum, um Finance von Grund auf neu zu denken. Hybrides Arbeiten mit Teamtagen in München: Mindestens zweimal pro Woche arbeiten wir gemeinsam im Münchner Büro, den Rest der Woche gestaltest du flexibel. Ansprechende Team-Events – Nimm an unseren Teamessen, Meet-ups und den legendären Partys teil. 30 Tage Urlaub – Tanke neue Energie und genieße eine großzügige Urlaubsregelung. Kostenlose Nutzung öffentlicher Verkehrsmittel in Deutschland – Mit dem Deutschlandticket Job bist du bestens versorgt. Zugang zu EGYM Wellness Pass – Nutze eine Vielzahl von Fitness- und Wellnessstudios, um dein körperliches und geistiges Wohlbefinden zu fördern. Bereit, mit uns durchzustarten? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Du kannst Dich direkt über unsere Karriereseite mit Deinem Lebenslauf bewerben. Warum Apaleo? Bei Apaleo zu arbeiten bedeutet mehr als nur eine Stelle anzutreten: Es geht darum, echte Veränderungen in der Hotellerie voranzutreiben. Deine Beiträge gestalten unsere innovative, API-first und zunehmend AI-first Plattform direkt mit, beeinflussen unternehmensweite Entscheidungen und helfen, die Zukunft der Hospitality-Technologie neu zu definieren. Bei Apaleo zählt deine Meinung, deine Ideen werden geschätzt, und dein Einfluss ist spürbar. Werde Teil eines Teams, in dem deine Arbeit den Fortschritt vorantreibt, Zusammenarbeit Innovationen hervorbringt und Wachstum ein gemeinsames Ziel ist. Wir sind stolz darauf, ein Arbeitgeber zu sein, der Chancengleichheit und Gleichstellung fördert und sich für einen vielfältigen, integrativen und einladenden Arbeitsplatz einsetzt. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Herkunft, unabhängig von Rasse, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlechtsidentität oder -ausdruck, Geschlecht, nationaler Herkunft, Alter, Familienstand, Behinderung oder anderen Merkmalen, die durch geltendes Recht geschützt sind. Deine personenbezogenen Daten werden mit größter Sorgfalt und in Übereinstimmung mit der DSGVO und den einschlägigen Datenschutzbestimmungen behandelt. description: At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers. From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection. As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance. Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches. We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn, backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started! Within Brevo, the Finance Department ensures that the company has, at all times, the financial resources required for its development. It guarantees that the company growth remains sustainable and profitable. The Sales Administration plays a key role in addressing three major challenges for their assigned customer portfolio: Build and maintain trust-based relationships with clients regarding all billing matters. Ensure that billing processes are aligned with accounting rules and contribute to their continuous improvement & ensure the Cash collection Support the sales team throughout the customer relationship lifecycle. Your impact at Brevo : 1. Client Relationship Management (Billing Focus) Give clients clarity on Brevo's billing model and respond to inquiries on contractual terms, pricing, and invoices. Support sales in resolving billing disputes; proactively flag billing errors, unpaid invoices, or budget overruns to clients and sales teams. Manage administrative follow-up of Order Forms, contracts, and POs. 2. Billing Process Management Register and manage Enterprise subscriptions; issue manual invoices per contract terms, delivered services, and pricing grids. Support monthly closing by preparing the list of invoices/credit notes to issue (1st of each month), ensuring recognized revenue matches delivered services. Monitor outstanding payments using accounting team data. 3. Cash Collection Execute cash collection: monitor, prioritize, and follow up on overdue accounts via email, phone, and other channels (including AI-generated alerts) to reduce overdue receivables and improve cash flow. Resolve and mitigate risk: resolve payment disputes and negotiate payment plans with Sales, CS, Finance, and Operations; anticipate risks and address root causes of delays; manage insolvency proceedings and submit claims when required. 4. Continuous Process Improvement Continuously improve billing and collection processes and tools, proposing enhancements, staying current on best-in-class solutions, joining efficiency working groups, and building AI agents and KPI dashboards to automate work and track performance. 5. Sales Support Onboard new clients on the billing process; assist with PO entry, collection, and budget tracking. This list of tasks is not exhaustive and may evolve based on business needs. Who you are : You have 10+ years of experience Expertise in billing and invoicing processes Experience with billing systems and tools Strong financial and accounting knowledge Proficiency in English is mandatory Rigorous and detail-oriented Strong communicator and a team player Adaptable and responsive to shifting priorities Why people love working at Brevo: A place to grow, together : Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighborhood. Experience supporting UAT, including test scenario preparation, test data coordination, feedback analysis, and defect or backlog item management. Familiarity with technical documentation, solution architecture, data models, APIs, and integration flows. Experience using documentation and collaboration tools such as SharePoint, Wiki, and backlog management platforms. Awareness of AI tools, including Copilot and AI agents, for requirements analysis, process improvement, and solution ideation. Strong communication, analytical, facilitation, problem-solving, and organizational skills. You will work closely with creators, agencies, and internal teams to bring that direction to life through high-quality short-form video and social creative. In partnership with the paid social team, you will help define the creative testing roadmap, using campaign insights and performance learnings to understand what resonates and continuously improve creative effectiveness over time. 

Paid social and online video are key channels for rapid learning and iteration. You will use those learnings to strengthen how we show up across channels and help evolve how the brand is expressed going forward. 

What You’ll Do 

  • Develop creative concepts and write scripts, hooks and copy for paid social and YouTube ads, drawing on audience needs, brand priorities and campaign learnings. Formats include creator-led videos, AI Videos, product demos, motion graphics, and static ads.

  • Own the creative testing roadmap: define hypotheses, test, learn, and iterate on creative concepts, hooks, creator types etc.

  • Explore AI tools and workflows to improve creative speed and efficiency

  • 8+ years of experience in brand, social creative, content strategy, or similar roles

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools for creative production or iteration. Experience in collaboration with an AI Video Content Creator or similar production role is a plus.  
  • Fluent English and German skills at minimum C1 level  
  • Experience scaling creator-led or UGC content strategies; experience working in international or multi-market environments is a plus

A community or social media management role  

A pure performance marketing or media buying role  

A traditional brand campaign role focused only on large launches  

An agency coordination role without creative ownership

Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an.
