description:
Mission Brief

At Isar Aerospace, we are building the technology and infrastructure needed to make access to space more affordable, sustainable, and scalable.

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on Senior Data Engineer to help design and build the foundation of our enterprise data platform.

As our organization grows, so does the complexity of our systems and the data they generate. You will play a key role in connecting our enterprise applications, engineering systems, and operational data sources, enabling reliable data exchange and creating a unified foundation for analytics, automation, and internally developed software applications.

You will work with systems such as SAP, Siemens Teamcenter, and other enterprise platforms to design scalable data pipelines, integration services, and a modern data lake architecture.

This is a foundational engineering role with significant technical ownership. You will have the opportunity to help define our data architecture, establish engineering standards, and build the infrastructure that enables our teams to access and utilize data across the organization.

We are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex integration challenges, is comfortable working with heterogeneous data sources, and combines strong engineering fundamentals with a pragmatic, hands-on approach.


Your role in our Space Mission...

Data Platform Architecture & Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines connecting enterprise applications, engineering systems, and operational data sources.
  • Help establish the architecture and technical foundation of a centralized enterprise data lake or lakehouse.
  • Independently build reliable ingestion, transformation, and data processing workflows supporting both batch and event-driven use cases.
  • Design data storage and processing layers that enable efficient access to structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data.
  • Define data models, transformation patterns, and data organization standards to ensure consistency across systems.
  • Implement monitoring, error handling, logging, and automated recovery mechanisms to maintain pipeline reliability.
  • Evaluate and recommend appropriate data technologies, frameworks, and architectural patterns.

Enterprise Systems Integration

  • Develop and maintain integrations with enterprise applications, including SAP ERP, Siemens Teamcenter PLM, and other internal platforms.
  • Work with APIs, databases, file-based interfaces, messaging systems, and enterprise integration technologies to enable reliable data exchange.
  • Extract, transform, and harmonize data from heterogeneous systems while preserving data integrity and traceability.
  • Develop reusable connectors, integration components, and data services to accelerate future integrations.
  • Collaborate with enterprise application owners to understand underlying data models, interfaces, and business processes.
  • Support appropriate data synchronization and interoperability between enterprise systems while respecting system-of-record ownership.

Data Engineering & Accessibility

  • Build data pipelines and curated datasets supporting internal applications, analytics, dashboards, and operational reporting.
  • Develop reusable data models and services that allow teams to access information across multiple systems.
  • Establish data quality checks, validation rules, lineage tracking, and metadata management practices.
  • Support the development of a consistent enterprise data foundation connecting engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, finance, and business operations.
  • Enable downstream use cases including business intelligence, advanced analytics, AI/ML, and process automation.
  • Optimize data processing performance, storage efficiency, and pipeline reliability as data volumes and organizational needs grow.

Engineering Excellence & Collaboration

  • Establish best practices for data engineering, including version control, automated testing, CI/CD, documentation, and infrastructure automation.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers developing internal applications and platforms.
  • Work directly with enterprise systems, engineering, manufacturing, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into technical solutions.
  • Apply appropriate security, access control, and data governance principles to enterprise data.
  • Leverage modern development tools, including AI-assisted coding, to accelerate implementation, testing, and troubleshooting.
  • Contribute to the evolution of our long-term enterprise data strategy and architecture.

What you´ll need to thrive...

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering, software engineering, or enterprise data integration.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, including the ability to develop production-quality data pipelines and services.
  • Extensive experience integrating heterogeneous data sources, including relational databases, APIs, and enterprise applications.
  • Strong knowledge of relational database technologies such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or comparable systems.
  • Experience developing ETL/ELT pipelines and implementing data transformation, validation, and orchestration workflows.
  • Experience with modern data platform architectures, including data lakes, data warehouses, or lakehouses.
  • Good understanding of data modeling, data quality and metadata management
  • Experience with workflow orchestration, scheduling, monitoring, and automated data processing.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, XML, and common enterprise data exchange patterns.
  • Experience using Git, CI/CD, automated testing, and modern software engineering practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently design, implement, and operate reliable data solutions.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to understand complex enterprise data models.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.

Nice to have...

  • Experience integrating enterprise platforms such as SAP ERP and PLM systems (e.g., Siemens Teamcenter)
  • Familiarity with engineering and manufacturing data structures, including Bills of Materials (BOMs), part revisions, product configurations, and material master data.
  • Familiarity with lakehouse technologies and open table formats such as Delta Lake or Apache Iceberg.
  • Experience with change data capture (CDC), event streaming, or message-based integration patterns.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and cloud-native development.
  • Experience working with enterprise data security, access management, and governance frameworks.
  • Experience supporting analytics, machine learning, or AI-ready data infrastructure.
  • Experience in aerospace, automotive, manufacturing, or other engineering-intensive industries.
  • Practical experience with AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or OpenAI Codex.

Beyond technical proficiency, we´re looking for someone who...

  • Builds, not just architects. You enjoy writing code, developing pipelines, troubleshooting integrations, and delivering working solutions.
  • Thinks beyond individual pipelines. You recognize the importance of reusable architecture, common data models, and long-term maintainability.
  • Collaborates effectively. You enjoy working with application owners, software engineers, and business stakeholders to solve real-world problems.
  • Embraces new technologies. You actively evaluate modern data technologies and development approaches, choosing solutions based on their practical value.

If you enjoy connecting complex systems, building reliable data infrastructure, and turning fragmented enterprise data into a scalable, accessible platform, we'd love to hear from you.

Benefits 

  • Employee Participation Program: Share in our success through our virtual company share program
  • 30 days of vacation: Enjoy the days off to relax and recharge
  • Company pension plan: Secure your future with our company pension plan, featuring a 20% employer contribution after the probation period
  • Subsidised lunch: Stay energised with delicious, subsidised lunches every day
  • Public transport ticket: Commute with ease using a fully financed Deutschlandticket
  • Rental clothing with laundry service: Enjoy hassle-free workwear with our convenient rental clothing and laundry service  
  • Sport Clubs membership: Stay fit with our sponsored sports club memberships (EGYM Wellpass)
  • Individual learning allowance: Grow your skills with an individual learning budget granted after the probation period
  • Childcare allowance: Receive a childcare allowance for your non-school-age children
  • And Much More! Discover additional perks and benefits when you join our team.         

Who we are

We are Isar Aerospace and we are at the forefront of New Space building a modern space business to enable faster, better and cheaper access to space.

Our mission is to help democratise space and use it for good in order to improve life on Earth now and for the future generations.

We are a fast-growing company aiming to provide sustainable and environmentally friendly launch solutions for small and medium-sized satellites and constellations into Low Earth Orbit. The company is privately funded by world-leading technology investors with strong commitment and support and our team is made of driven and talented people with a real passion for space innovation.

We're making rockets in a way that hasn't been done before disrupting a traditional industry. If you are up for the challenge, want to work on cutting-edge projects and be part of a team changing the world for better, come, join us and launch your career!

Want to find out more about us?

Visit www.isaraerospace.com

 

Data Protection
We process your personal data for the purpose of managing the recruitment process and assessing your application. For detailed information on how your data is processed, including your rights, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

 

Disclaimer
Isar Aerospace SE is an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced engineering leader to become our Senior Director of Engineering for Civil Government and Commercial. In this role, you will lead the engineering strategy, execution, and team development for a rapidly growing organization of 70+ engineers spanning multiple global Planet offices. You will oversee the development, scaling, and delivery of our critical existing solutions, including Area Monitoring Service (AMS) for EU Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) compliance, Disaster and Wildfire solutions, Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE), and a portfolio of Derived Data Products. You will also drive our "zero to one" product discovery, partnering closely with Product Management, Design, and Science teams to incubate, architect, and launch new, emerging solutions built on top of Planet’s high-frequency imagery and derived data products. AI is central to how Planet builds solutions, and you will make it a primary way your teams discover, build, and deliver for customers. This position is vital to delivering innovative applications to civil governments and commercial customers worldwide.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem, or Ljubljana office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a global engineering organization of 70+ engineers, managers, and directors across multiple geographies and time zones.
  • Set a high bar for performance and accountability. Define measurable outcomes for every product and team, surface risks early and directly, and make the hard calls on people and priorities when results fall short.
  • Drive the day-to-day engineering execution and delivery for existing flagship products, ensuring reliability and performance for AMS,  Disaster and Wildfire solutions, and the derived data portfolio.
  • Champion and lead "zero to one" engineering discovery, building the technical foundation and prototypes for new emerging commercial and civil government products.
  • Partner on a daily basis with Product Management, Design, and GTM teams to define product direction, prioritize feature development, and align technical strategy with business goals.
  • Ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and secure for government and enterprise use, guiding architectural decisions and engineering best practices.
  • Align your team's daily output with Planet’s mission of using space to help life on earth, directly enabling governments and businesses to make critical, timely decisions.

What You Bring:

  • 10+ years of relevant software engineering work experience, including 8+ years of supervisory or leadership experience managing multiple layers of engineering management.
  • Experience leading and scaling distributed engineering teams of 50+ employees across multiple geographic locations and time zones.
  • Hands-on engagement with AI tools in your own work, and experience leading engineering teams through AI adoption.
  • Track record of "zero to one" product development, including the technical discovery, architecture, and successful launch of new software solutions.
  • Background in building and delivering geospatial platforms, data analytics solutions, or enterprise SaaS products.

description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. The team At blp, dedicated engineering teams own individual products such as invoices, customer orders, and order confirmations. The Platform Team owns what all of them are built on: shared services and APIs, the data access layer, and the component and design system that shape how the product looks and behaves. The team's focus has been the frontend platform, and we are now deliberately extending that ownership deeper into the stack. You would be central to that shift, with real influence over how the platform layer gets defined rather than inheriting someone else's blueprint. About the role What you'll do and for whom. You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day. Where you'll work. You join the Platform Team, about 10 engineers. At BLP, platform means the core of our product, not internal infrastructure: the shared services, data access layer, and design system that every product runs on. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns. What success looks like. In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it. What you'll do Build the service that product teams build on. Design, build, and evolve the core APIs behind document processing, approval workflows, administration, and analytics, with clear contracts so product teams can ship on top of them without workarounds. Own the persistence layer. Each tenant has its own isolated MySQL database. You evolve the abstraction product teams build on (a tenant-scoped unit of work, typed repositories, and shared type-safe querying) so that isolation, transactions, and permissions are right by default. Scale BLP for large enterprises. Extend our cross-tenant capabilities so customers with many subsidiaries and business units can manage users, permissions, and documents across all of them from one place, correctly, securely, and fast. Own email, in and out. Own our email document ingestion and outbound email services, including the audit trail and its UI. Make setup self-service. Turn manual SSO, SCIM, and email setups into migration tools and admin UIs that customers and project managers can run on their own. Work with customers. Join onboarding calls with customer IT teams and project managers, get their setups running, and turn what you learn into better tooling. Own it end-to-end. From the Go service through the React UI to production, including tracing, metrics, and incident analysis after it ships. Tech stack: Go, React/TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, Temporal, Kubernetes on GCP and AWS, GitHub CI/CD, and OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, and Parca for observability. We're excited about you because You have 4+ years of experience as a software engineer, with most of that time spent building and operating backend systems in production. You have 2+ years of professional Go experience, writing services that run in production, not side projects. You've designed a backend service or API that other teams depended on, and kept it reliable and evolvable as usage grew. You work well across teams. You align with product, integration, and infrastructure teams on contracts, priorities, and rollouts, and you can explain technical trade-offs to people who aren't engineers. You improve existing production systems step by step, and you know when a rewrite isn't worth it. You have strong fundamentals in type systems, composition, testing, and clean architecture, and you're comfortable working in a codebase built on functional patterns. You're fullstack where it counts: you build on the components and design system our frontend experts maintain to ship admin UIs quickly, even though the backend is where you do your deepest work. You think in products and take ownership. You translate business problems into precise specifications, weigh cost against benefit, work directly with customers when a setup needs it, and stay responsible for what you ship after it goes live. Strong plus Experience with distributed systems, Kubernetes, Temporal, or cloud infrastructure. Experience with user provisioning (SCIM) and SSO (OIDC). Experience running multi-tenant systems. Domain knowledge in ERP, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes, or German language skills. What you'll get Ownership of visible outcomes. The areas you own decide how fast enterprise customers go live and how well BLP scales with them. Impact at scale. Every improvement you ship to the product core multiplies across all product teams and the 20'000+ people who use BLP daily. Senior scope from day one. You'll lead technical initiatives and mentor engineers on a team that is actively growing its backend ownership. Learn more about BLP and our values at blp.digital/company/careers. description: De opdracht Van veranderkundig advies naar daadwerkelijke verandering. Daar ligt jouw opdracht. Voor twee veranderopgaven binnen het sociaal domein van de gemeente Den Haag zoeken we een ervaren senior implementatiemanager die veranderkundige expertise combineert met implementatiekracht. Ben jij een ervaren implementatiemanager die beweging weet te creëren in complexe maatschappelijke opgaven? Kun jij veranderkundige inzichten verbinden aan concrete resultaten en beschik je over de kracht om veranderingen daadwerkelijk te laten landen in de praktijk? Breng jij structuur en voortgang, zie je patronen en heb je oog voor belangen, krijg je mensen in beweging en kun je tegelijkertijd het eigenaarschap van de lijn versterken? Dan ben jij de senior implementatiemanager die we zoeken voor de ondersteuning van de teams Wet Maatschappelijke Ondersteuning (Wmo) en Jeugdgezondheidszorg (JGZ) binnen het Sociaal Domein. Er liggen twee uitdagende opdrachten waarbij organisatieontwikkeling, cultuurverandering en implementatie hand in hand gaan, daarnaast ben jij ook in de lead voor een pilot passend bij de twee opdrachten. Wat ga je doen? Als Senior Implementatiemanager begeleid je complexe verandertrajecten van ontwerp naar uitvoering. Je brengt structuur, regie en voortgang aan in trajecten waarin al denkwerk is verricht, maar waar de daadwerkelijke implementatie en borging nog vorm moet krijgen. Je werkt nauw samen met opdrachtgevers, managementteams, medewerkers en interne adviseurs. Daarbij zorg je ervoor dat plannen niet op papier blijven staan, maar worden vertaald naar concrete veranderingen in werkwijzen, processen, gedrag en samenwerking. Je: · brengt regie, structuur, tempo en doe-kracht in de verander- en implementatietrajecten; · ontwikkelt en begeleidt implementatieaanpakken die bijdragen aan duurzame verandering; · hebt sterke veranderkundige vaardigheden en het vermogen om gedrag, cultuur en leiderschap bespreekbaar te maken; · hebt bewezen implementatiekracht: je weet veranderingen te vertalen naar concrete acties, resultaten en borging; · hebt ervaring met transitievraagstukken en het begeleiden van organisaties in verandering; · adviseert over risico's, aanpak en passende veranderinterventies; · stimuleert bewustwording, dialoog, eigenaarschap en samenwerking; · maakt verschillende perspectieven en patronen zichtbaar en bespreekbaar; · ontwikkelt praktische tools en werkvormen die de verandering ondersteunen; · bewaakt voortgang en resultaten en stuurt bij waar nodig. Je weet daarbij effectief te schakelen tussen denken en doen, richting geven en ruimte bieden, tempo maken en reflecteren. Naast de twee veranderopgaven ben je in de lead voor de pilot rondom implementatie- en transitiemanagement, waar deze opdracht de input voor levert voor de afdeling Opgaven & Ontwikkeling. Op basis van je ervaringen binnen de twee teams (WMO en JGZ) breng je in kaart welke expertise, rollen en capaciteit nodig zijn om dergelijke veranderopgaven in de toekomst goed te ondersteunen. Jouw formele opdrachtgever is één van de managers van het team Organisatieontwikkeling voor dit deel van jouw opdracht. Wie zoeken wij? Je bent een stevige, zelfstandige en resultaatgerichte professional die complexe veranderopgaven kan doorgronden én realiseren. Je beweegt gemakkelijk tussen management en medewerkers, creëert draagvlak en bent organisatiesensitief. Je beweegt je op het snijvlak van organisatieontwikkeling, verandermanagement en implementatiemanagement. We zoeken iemand die veranderkundige scherpte combineert met implementatiekracht en management en teams helpt om de verandering zélf te realiseren. Iemand die begrijpt wat nodig is om mensen mee te nemen in verandering, maar die tegelijkertijd zorgt voor structuur, voortgang en realisatie. Een professional die helpt richting te geven aan een verandering én ervoor zorgt dat deze daadwerkelijk wordt geïmplementeerd en duurzaam wordt verankerd binnen de organisatie. We want to deepen and broaden the skills we already have in the group, and to add to its great culture. This role would suit someone in the early stages of their career, looking for a new challenge within an innovative company.

This team works predominantly across healthcare projects, and you will use your engineering skills at all stages of the development life-cycle, taking responsibility for design challenges and technical problems.

The majority of your time will be spent delivering exceptional mechanical engineering for our multi-national medical technology clients, understanding their requirements and communicating clearly and effectively. You will be hands-on in solving complex mechanical challenges, often alongside other disciplines, within supportive project teams.

You will work on projects across a range of healthcare sectors, including medical devices, drug delivery, surgical systems and diagnostics instruments. The technical challenges we tackle are ground-breaking, innovative and make a real difference to the landscape of medical technology.

You will guide aspects of the mechanical development and define technical solutions, using your experience to design systems and parts for manufacture by applying real-world knowledge. Your work is likely to include:

  • First-principles engineering analysis
  • Concept generation and the development of engineering designs
  • Rapid prototyping
  • Hands-on testing and experimentation, including the design and execution of test programmes
  • Detailed design for manufacture and assembly, and liaising with suppliers
  • Presenting results, both internally and to clients
  • Preparing technical reports and producing high-quality documentation

We are keen to support the development of our employees, and as such offer an extensive in-house training program. As you advance within the organisation there will be plenty of opportunities for you to develop your technical skills and specialism, take on more leadership responsibilities and/or focus more on supporting the development of sales opportunities.

You’ll bring strong mechanical engineering ability and enthusiasm to the role. You will deliver high-quality work on client projects, to specification and to timelines. You will be responsible for delivering the tasks you’re assigned, and for defining tasks for yourself and often for others.

We’re looking for applicants who can demonstrate:

  • An excellent undergraduate degree in Mechanical Engineering (or a related subject such as Biomedical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering or Mechatronics) or equivalent experience
  • Design engineering industry experience, for example (but not limited to) high proficiency in CAD (e.g. SolidWorks), design analysis, structural analysis, rapid prototyping, technical drawings, design for manufacture and design for assembly

In addition, experience in any of the following would be advantageous (but is not essential):

  • Experience in a consulting environment
  • Experience in medical device development, or other regulated product development
  • Familiarity with analysis tools such as Python/MATLAB, CFD and FEA

What we do

Cambridge Consultants is one of the world’s leading product development and technology consultancies, with a reputation for cutting-edge design, development and value creation for a global client base. We develop breakthrough technology for some of the most exciting companies on the planet. Our people, facilities and work make us unique.   • A variety of events organised by our social committee, ranging from summer and Christmas parties to board game nights and socials at our own rooftop bar!

 

Why Cambridge Consultants?

At Cambridge Consultants, you'll contribute to radical, new-to-the-world innovation that transforms business, society and the planet. Joining our multidisciplinary teams means helping to turn bold ideas into reality, harnessing the power of deep tech to create products, services and experiences that have never existed before. With the Attendi App, we are building a one-stop solution for AI-driven administration in healthcare: structured documentation, conversation summaries, voice-driven workflows and AI assistance, anytime, anywhere. Our product and development team is growing fast. Our Product Lead, a former nurse, owns the what and the why: our users, the roadmap and experiments. To keep up with the pace, we’re looking for someone who owns the how and the when: turning that roadmap into well-structured, realistic and predictable delivery, together with our development team leads. Your Role As Senior Product Owner at Attendi, you will: Translate roadmap items, experiments and MVPs into epics and user stories, with clear acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements (performance, security, privacy, platforms). Own the development backlog in Jira: clear, up to date and one to two sprints ahead with work that’s ready to build. Set up and guard our Definition of Ready and Definition of Done. Prepare and lead refinement and sprint planning with our dev team leads. Propose 6-week cycle goals and sprint goals, based on capacity, dependencies, risk and effort. Propose the balance between features, bugs, tech debt and maintenance. Be the first point of contact for developers on tickets, and handle small scope questions yourself. Spot blockers, risks and delays early and solve them with the dev leads. Help turn uncertain AI work into small, measurable experiments. Accept delivered work, prepare phased rollouts and pilots, and write release notes for sales, implementation and support. Make sure our requirements are traceable from requirement to story, test and release, as required for our medical device (MDR) certification. Align technically with EHR vendors and partners on integrations, APIs and releases. Make progress visible with Jira dashboards and delivery metrics. You might be a good fit if you hit most or all of the following: 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner in software product teams. Strong command of Scrum and agile delivery, and you know when to adapt it. Technical enough to discuss solutions with engineers, understand trade-offs and help make realistic estimates. You keep the customer at the centre of the backlog, and link technical work to what users need. You love structure: a clear backlog, a steady rhythm and predictable delivery give you energy. Low ego, high ownership. You’re a builder who wants to ship a bit better every week. You move fast, but carefully. You understand that in healthcare, getting it right matters. Experience with Jira. Fluent in English. Strong candidates may also Have a background in software engineering. Have experience with AI products, and with an AI-native way of working. Have worked in healthcare or another regulated environment, for example with MDR, IEC 62304 or similar. Have worked with integrations and external partners. Speak Dutch. What we offer Ideally 32 hours per week. €6,000 - €7,000 per month (based on 40h) Hybrid working: roughly half the week at home, half at our Amsterdam office. Travel and lunch allowance. Home office budget. Lease bike. Training budget of €1,500 per year. Company MacBook. ClassPass membership. Pension contribution of 10% and roughly 7% paid by Attendi. Our culture: People-oriented, curious, and proactive At Attendi, you’ll work in a small, ambitious team that learns and builds together. We are empathetic, take initiative, dare to experiment, and stand by our work. Making mistakes is okay as long as you learn from them. About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

Our Infrastructure teams build the foundation that engineers at Wolt, Deliveroo, and DoorDash build on: the compute, cloud, and networking capabilities that enable Engineering teams to develop, deploy, and run services at global scale. The EU Compute team has a specific focus on provisioning, scaling, and the efficient operation of GPU infrastructure for AI and ML workloads. This is an emerging space with plenty of greenfield opportunities.

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to be a hands-on technical leader for this infrastructure work that crosses team and brand boundaries. You'll set direction for the platform, turn complex problems into deliverable plans, write and review production code, and help other engineers make sound decisions. It's an exciting time to join: we're building a global platform and the choices made now will shape how engineers across the company ship for years.

What you’ll be doing

You'll own some of the hardest infrastructure problems in the company and make the platform easier to operate and safer to build on. We’re determined to build great platform products and user experiences, and you’ll be pivotal in making this reality.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

  • Set technical direction for shared AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure, balancing reliability, security, developer experience, and cost.
  • Lead substantial initiatives from design through rollout and operation, coordinating dependencies and decisions across Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash, focusing on workloads targeting GPUs.
  • Evolve Kubernetes clusters, cloud networking, identity, and infrastructure provisioning to support growing and varied workloads.
  • Build reusable Terraform patterns and self-service tooling that help teams provision infrastructure safely and consistently.
  • Improve deployment and operational practices, including GitOps, observability, capacity planning, incident response and recovery.
  • Use production signals and developer feedback to find platform friction, choose where to invest and measure whether changes actually help.
  • Assist with supporting the platform, with deep focus on GPU infrastructure, as well as broad focus on compute in general.
  • Gracefully sunset legacy infrastructure and tooling, and create strategies to reduce toil.
  • Mentor engineers through design reviews, implementation and incidents, raising the quality of infrastructure work across teams.

Our humble expectations

  • Deep experience building and operating Kubernetes and AWS infrastructure in production. Familiarity with GPU workloads and orchestration is a plus.
  • Strong software engineering skills: you use Go, Python or a similar language to build maintainable tools and automation.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (we use Terraform) and with designing systems that other engineering teams depend on.
  • A track record of leading complex technical work across teams, including architectural decisions, delivery, and operational follow-through. You have the breadth to collaborate and design across team and domain boundaries, and the depth to have hands-on impact.
  • Strong judgment on trade-offs in distributed systems, networking, security, reliability, and cloud cost.
  • Clear communication, and the ability to bring people together around a practical technical direction.

What we offer

  • Scope and influence. Shape infrastructure used globally, while staying close to the engineering. Your work will help product teams ship services with greater ease and confidence.
  • Real problems at global scale. Multi-cluster Kubernetes, AI / ML workloads, cloud networking, GitOps, and progressive delivery across a global company.
  • Autonomy and ownership. Set direction and see it through from design to operation, with the backing of a global engineering organisation spanning Europe and the US.
  • Growth. Room to expand your scope, whether through deeper technical leadership or broader cross-domain influence.
  • Great people. Work with talented engineers and leaders in a diverse, international environment, mentoring and learning from others.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Onze organisatie, werkzaamheden en processen zijn continu in ontwikkeling. Dat betekent dat ook arbeidsrisico's kunnen veranderen. Tijdens deze stage voer jij daarom een onafhankelijke review uit van de bestaande RI&E en het bijbehorende Plan van Aanpak. Je blijft daarbij niet achter je bureau zitten. Je gaat de werkvloer op, voert veiligheidsrondes uit, spreekt met medewerkers en leidinggevenden en analyseert onder andere incidenten, near misses, hazard reports, werkplekinspecties en andere beschikbare veiligheidsinformatie. Je onderzoekt verschillende werkomgevingen binnen NX Filtration, waaronder productie, logistiek, maintenance & facilities, laboratorium/QC en kantoor. De centrale vraag tijdens jouw stage is: “In hoeverre sluit de huidige RI&E van NX Filtration aan op de actuele risico's binnen de organisatie en welke verbetermaatregelen hebben de hoogste prioriteit?” Wie zijn wij NX Filtration produceert membraanfilters die wereldwijd worden gebruikt om de kleinste vervuilingen uit water te filteren. Denk hierbij aan vervuilingen zoals nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. Dit heeft geresulteerd in nieuwe en eenvoudige processen voor de behandeling van water, het hergebruik van afvalwater en de productie van drinkwater. Het motto van NX Filtration is “schoon en betaalbaar water voor iedereen”. In 2024 is een geheel nieuwe, zeer moderne fabriek in Hengelo in gebruik genomen. Wat vragen we van jou? Je volgt een relevante HBO-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld: Integrale Veiligheidskunde, Milieukunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde, of een vergelijkbare technische of veiligheidskundige opleiding. Je hebt interesse in HSE, arbeidsveiligheid, productieprocessen en continu verbeteren. Je werkt analytisch, zorgvuldig en gestructureerd. Je durft medewerkers en leidinggevenden op verschillende niveaus te interviewen. Je kunt waarnemingen objectief vastleggen en vertalen naar concrete en uitvoerbare verbetervoorstellen. Je bent praktisch ingesteld en vindt het leuk om zowel zelfstandig als met verschillende afdelingen samen te werken. Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed en bij voorkeur ook de Engelse taal. Wat bieden we jou? Een impactvolle stage op het gebied van HSE en arbeidsveiligheid, met een stagevergoeding á €500,00 (o.b.v. 40 uur). description: 🚀 Join SE3 Labs as (Senior) UAV / Robotics Integration Field Engineer - Hardware Be the person who makes advanced autonomous systems work in the real world. Move across the full stack: drones, sensors, calibration, autonomy software, perception, networking, payloads, field operations, and partner environments. When the system is not mission-ready, you create clarity, find the root cause, and help make it robust. About SE3 SE3 Labs is building Spatial AI by combining 3D computer vision with large language models. We believe the ability to reason about and act within physical space is foundational to unlocking the next generation of automation, from construction to smart infrastructure, and ultimately, defence. Now, we’re bringing Spatial AI into the sky through high-performance UAVs that can perceive, localize, coordinate, and act in the real world. This requires more than strong algorithms and good hardware. It requires systems that can be configured, calibrated, tested, deployed, demonstrated, debugged, and improved under real field conditions. We’re looking for a hands-on engineer who wants to work close to the product, close to the field, and close to the full autonomy stack. Someone who is not limited to one layer, but follows the problem wherever it leads. About the Role As (Senior) UAV / Robotics Integration Engineer, you will be the part of SE3’s engineering team to bring our technology into real-world use. You will bring together UAVs, payloads, sensors, onboard compute, autonomy software, operator tools, and partner environments into systems that are ready to fly, test, demonstrate, and deploy. This is a highly hands-on, end-to-end prototyping and field engineering role. You will work directly with other startups, prime contractors, and military institutions, translating their requirements into practical mechanical and electrical designs building on our existing technology. When something is not working, you go where the evidence leads: recalibrate a sensor, debug a radio link, inspect a wiring harness, analyse a flight log, fix a configuration issue, improve a checklist, or bring the right evidence back to the software development team. The problems you will work on are complex, dynamic, and multivariable. You will often have partial information, limited time, and a system where hardware, software, environment, and operator behavior interact in non-obvious ways. Your job is to create clarity, choose the right debugging path, and drive the system toward a robust long-term solution. You will not just operate systems. You will make them better. What You’ll Work On Own the integration project: Consult with partners, clarify requirements, agree interfaces and test criteria, and drive technical decisions and milestones to a working joint system. Cross-Stack Engineering: Design integration concepts, CAD models, electrical circuits and system integration and bring together sensors, enclosures, calibration, compute, mechanisms, power electronics, controls, networking, autonomy software, and operator workflows. Validation & Fieldability Ownership: Put your system through its paces: on test stands and in the field. Spot design flaws, integration gaps, recurring failure modes, and process bottlenecks. And establish confidence in mission-readiness as the maturity is realized. Create clarity in complex situations: Separate symptoms from root causes, devise efficient debugging workflows, reproduce failures and drive lasting solutions that make the system more robust long term. When the root cause requires it, contribute directly to the layer that matters, drawing directly from the experts who develop core components of your system. Acceptance & Testing Automation: Define and run acceptance tests for platforms, payloads, and deployment configurations. Own readiness checks across calibration, software flashing, networking, sensors, and pre-mission setup. Make readiness measurable and repeatable. Field Deployment & End-User Interface: Install, configure, maintain, and support SE3 systems at test ranges, customer sites, partner demonstrations, exercises, and real-world deployments. Make sure our autonomous platforms perform reliably where it matters, enable end-users to succeed in their missions and represent SE3 with technical credibility outside the lab. Your Profile Most importantly, you’re structured, fast-moving, and mission-driven. You don’t wait for perfect information. You create clarity, iterate fast, and prefer finding and fixing root causes over applying patches. You hold a B.Sc., M.Sc. or similar degree in Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, or a related field. You bring multiple years of hands-on experience integrating, testing, operating, and troubleshooting complex robotic, UAV, embedded, automotive, industrial automation, or defence systems. You are proficient in using CAD software, creating wiring diagrams, building electromechanic prototypes and defining and executing test campaigns across hardware disciplines. You are familiar with soldering, crimping, using multimeters, oscilloscopes, serial consoles, or other lab and field equipment, with at least basic experience in command line, data analysis tools and Linux usage. You are proactive, hands-on and able to find effective solutions also under the constraints of field-campaigns and willing to travel and deploy across Europe. You enjoy working directly with partners, operators, and end users. You can explain technical problems clearly, build trust in stressful situations, and represent SE3 professionally outside the lab. You speak fluent English; German is a strong plus. A driving license is required. Given the nature of SE3’s work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects and, where required, obtain the relevant security clearance. Especially Valued Bonus Skills Specific knowledge in UAVs, PX4, ArduPilot, QGroundControl, Mission Planner, MAVLink, flight log analysis, mission planning, and airspace coordination. Proficiency in PCBA and electronics circuit design and prototyping, especially targeting high-speed data interfaces and sensors Experience with development on ROS2, Docker, Linux, edge compute devices, C++/Python, Bash, Git, or deployment automation. Experience with networking and radio systems, including WiFi networks, LTE/5G modems, VPNs, telemetry links, antenna placement, RF interference, tactical communication links, and debugging connectivity issues in the field. Experience with perception or measurement systems, camera/IMU calibration, sensor synchronization, image processing, or mission autonomy. Skills interpreting sensor data, robot logs, flight logs, frequency-domain data, vibration issues, EMI issues, thermal issues, or intermittent hardware failures. Experience with environmental testing such as vibration, thermal, ingress protection, EMI/EMC, or MIL-STD-style qualification workflows. Experience creating acceptance tests, runbooks, troubleshooting- or training guides, fleet dashboards, release checklists, or field-support processes. Design and implement data strategies, ensuring data integrity and enforcing governance policies. Establish protocols to handle data, safeguard sensitive information, and optimize data usage within the organization. Design and advise on data quality rules and set up effective data compliance policies. Must have skills : Graph Databases Good to have skills : Neo4j, Python Frameworks Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: As a Data Management Practitioner, a typical day involves overseeing the stewardship of an organization's data assets to ensure they meet quality and compliance standards. This role includes designing and implementing comprehensive data strategies that uphold data integrity and enforce governance policies. The practitioner establishes and maintains protocols for managing data securely, protecting sensitive information, and optimizing the use of data across various departments. Additionally, they provide guidance on data quality standards and develop effective compliance policies to support organizational objectives and regulatory requirements. Write and optimize complex SPARQL, Cypher, and Gremlin queries for production graph workloads including traversal, inference, and aggregation. - Implement SHACL or ShEx constraints and automated validation pipelines to enforce data conformance against ontology schemas. - Develop APIs and microservices that expose graph data to downstream consumers — including search, recommendation, and LLM/RAG pipelines. - Integrate knowledge graph layers with vector databases and embedding models to support hybrid semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation. - Collaborate with ontology designers to implement and version ontology changes safely in production without disrupting dependent services. - Monitor graph platform performance, diagnose bottlenecks, and drive reliability improvements across ingestion and query layers. - Conduct code reviews, define engineering standards, and mentor mid-level and junior developers on graph engineering best practices. - Contribute to documentation, runbooks, and internal tooling to support the broader knowledge graph team's productivity. - Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform. - Responsible for team decisions. - Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions. - Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams. - Lead initiatives to improve data governance frameworks and ensure alignment with organizational goals. - Facilitate communication and coordination between cross-functional teams to promote data compliance and quality. - Mentor junior team members to support their professional growth and enhance team capabilities. title: Knowledge Engineer

description: Project Role : Knowledge Engineer Project Role Description : Design and structure knowledge frameworks that enable AI systems to reason and make informed decisions. Capture and translate expert and unstructured knowledge into ontologies, knowledge graphs, and semantic models, ensuring accuracy and context for automation and insights. Apply advanced analytics on knowledge graphs to drive problem-solving and actionable insights. Must have skills : Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform Good to have skills : Data Engineering, Graph Databases, Neo4j Minimum 12 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Role Summary / Description AI Powered Tech Talent Senior Engineer role in Knowledge Engineering focused on designing, building, and leading significant workstreams for enterprise-scale Knowledge Graph, semantic layer, ontology, and AI knowledge solutions using Databricks lakehouse and AI capabilities. The role leads a substantial knowledge engineering scope within a large program, translates real-world business problems into scalable AI and KG solutions, guides technical direction, and contributes to thought leadership, reusable assets, and delivery standards. The role must bring relevant industry experience across domains such as BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or life sciences, applying semantic AI, knowledge graphs, LLM grounding, governed data products, lakehouse pipelines, and Databricks engineering patterns to deliver measurable client value. Key Responsibilities Engineer Databricks-based knowledge engineering solutions using Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, Workflows, MLflow, Feature Engineering, Vector Search, Model Serving, notebooks, jobs, APIs, and cloud storage integrations. Build lakehouse graph ingestion pipelines, semantic data products, vector integrations, LLM grounding layers, APIs, and governed access patterns on Databricks while improving performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency. Lead the build of Knowledge Graph solutions that transform client data architecture within a large program scope. Direct the design, development, and implementation of AI, semantic layer, ontology, taxonomy, schema, graph modeling, and knowledge curation solutions, ensuring all components work together seamlessly. Work with project leaders, delivery leads, client stakeholders, architects, data engineers, AI engineers, product teams, and domain SMEs to create standout graph-powered data and AI offerings. Develop strong client relationships, earn trust as a key advisor, and explain the business value of semantic layer, ontology, and knowledge graph solutions. Make the business case for the recommended semantic layer solution and contribute meaningfully to sales, pre-sales, estimation, proposal inputs, and solution shaping activities. Provide thought leadership on technology trends, innovation opportunities, limitations, risks, delivery concerns, and practical adoption of knowledge graphs, semantic AI, LLM grounding, RAG, and agentic systems. Design, evaluate, and maintain ontologies, schemas, standards, and reusable engineering patterns, while guiding teams on data model quality and implementation methods. Lead a team or workstream within a larger program, mentor engineers, review design/code/configuration, and guide adoption of new methodologies, model building techniques, and algorithms. Collaborate across business and technical teams to drive end-to-end delivery for the assigned scope and demonstrate value to business and technology stakeholders. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience with Knowledge Graph technologies such as RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL, OWL, graph query languages, schema design, ontology management, and KG curation. Minimum 3 years of experience in schema design, ontology management, semantic modeling, taxonomy management, metadata management, and knowledge graph curation. Minimum 3 years of experience designing and developing Knowledge Graph solutions and graph-based ML models across functional and technical workstreams. Minimum 2 years of experience implementing end-to-end data pipelines for AI applications, especially LLM-enabled or enterprise knowledge applications, with hands-on design and configuration. Minimum 4 years of experience with relational databases, object stores, graph databases such as Stardog, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune or equivalent, and vector databases. Minimum 2 years of experience leading a team or workstream within a larger program. Experience collaborating with engineering, research, product, domain, client-facing, and cross-functional teams across multiple time zones. Required Skills/ Experience Hands-on experience building Databricks-based knowledge engineering solutions with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, Workflows, MLflow, Feature Engineering, Vector Search, Model Serving, notebooks, jobs, APIs, and cloud storage integrations. Strong Python, SQL, and Spark/PySpark experience with frameworks and tools such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, SPARQL, SHACL, Apache Airflow, Apache NiFi, and ETL/ELT pipeline tooling. Practical knowledge of NLP and search techniques including entity extraction, entity resolution, semantic search, prompt engineering, LLM grounding, and enterprise-scale LLM applications. Ability to design and implement scalable lakehouse graph ingestion, ontology/schema pipelines, semantic layers, vector search/retrieval patterns, RAG pipelines, and governed knowledge services. Strong collaboration, technical leadership, delivery ownership, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills. Good to Have Skills 2+ years of hands-on experience with cloud/data platforms, with Databricks specialization and exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP in multi-cloud environments. Databricks certifications such as Data Engineer Professional, Machine Learning Professional, or related lakehouse credentials. Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or life sciences, including domain ontologies, data models, compliance needs, and knowledge-driven use cases. External client-facing consulting experience, proposal support, solution shaping, or pre-sales exposure. title: Knowledge Engineer

description: Project Role : Knowledge Engineer Project Role Description : Design and structure knowledge frameworks that enable AI systems to reason and make informed decisions. Capture and translate expert and unstructured knowledge into ontologies, knowledge graphs, and semantic models, ensuring accuracy and context for automation and insights. Apply advanced analytics on knowledge graphs to drive problem-solving and actionable insights. Must have skills : Google Cloud Data Services Good to have skills : Data Engineering, Graph Databases, Neo4j Minimum 12 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Role Summary / Description AI Powered Tech Talent Senior Engineer role in Knowledge Engineering focused on designing, building, and leading significant workstreams for enterprise-scale Knowledge Graph, semantic layer, ontology, and AI knowledge solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The role leads a substantial knowledge engineering scope within a large program, translates real-world business problems into scalable AI and KG solutions, guides technical direction, and contributes to thought leadership, reusable assets, and delivery standards. The role must bring relevant industry experience across domains such as BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or life sciences, applying semantic AI, knowledge graphs, LLM grounding, data pipelines, and cloud-native engineering patterns to deliver measurable client value. Key Responsibilities Engineer GCP-based knowledge engineering solutions using services such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Dataproc, Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, IAM, Cloud Logging/Monitoring, APIs, and graph/vector ecosystem services. Build graph ingestion pipelines, semantic data products, vector integrations, LLM grounding layers, APIs, and governed access patterns on GCP while improving performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency. Lead the build of Knowledge Graph solutions that transform client data architecture within a large program scope. Direct the design, development, and implementation of AI, semantic layer, ontology, taxonomy, schema, graph modeling, and knowledge curation solutions, ensuring all components work together seamlessly. Work with project leaders, delivery leads, client stakeholders, architects, data engineers, AI engineers, product teams, and domain SMEs to create standout graph-powered data and AI offerings. Develop strong client relationships, earn trust as a key advisor, and explain the business value of semantic layer, ontology, and knowledge graph solutions. Make the business case for the recommended semantic layer solution and contribute meaningfully to sales, pre-sales, estimation, proposal inputs, and solution shaping activities. Provide thought leadership on technology trends, innovation opportunities, limitations, risks, delivery concerns, and practical adoption of knowledge graphs, semantic AI, LLM grounding, RAG, and agentic systems. Design, evaluate, and maintain ontologies, schemas, standards, and reusable engineering patterns, while guiding teams on data model quality and implementation methods. Lead a team or workstream within a larger program, mentor engineers, review design/code/configuration, and guide adoption of new methodologies, model building techniques, and algorithms. Collaborate across business and technical teams to drive end-to-end delivery for the assigned scope and demonstrate value to business and technology stakeholders. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience with Knowledge Graph technologies such as RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL, OWL, graph query languages, schema design, ontology management, and KG curation. Minimum 3 years of experience in schema design, ontology management, semantic modeling, taxonomy management, metadata management, and knowledge graph curation. Minimum 3 years of experience designing and developing Knowledge Graph solutions and graph-based ML models across functional and technical workstreams. Minimum 2 years of experience implementing end-to-end data pipelines for AI applications, especially LLM-enabled or enterprise knowledge applications, with hands-on design and configuration. Minimum 4 years of experience with relational databases, object stores, graph databases such as Stardog, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune or equivalent, and vector databases. Minimum 2 years of experience leading a team or workstream within a larger program. Experience collaborating with engineering, research, product, domain, client-facing, and cross-functional teams across multiple time zones. Required Skills/ Experience Hands-on experience building GCP-based knowledge engineering solutions with BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Dataproc, Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, IAM, APIs, and cloud-native monitoring/security services. Strong Python experience with frameworks and tools such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, PySpark, SQL, SPARQL, SHACL, Apache Airflow, Apache NiFi, and ETL/ELT pipeline tooling. Practical knowledge of NLP and search techniques including entity extraction, entity resolution, semantic search, prompt engineering, LLM grounding, and enterprise-scale LLM applications. Ability to design and implement scalable graph ingestion, ontology/schema pipelines, semantic layers, vector search/retrieval patterns, RAG pipelines, and governed knowledge services. Strong collaboration, technical leadership, delivery ownership, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills. Good to Have Skills 2+ years of hands-on experience with cloud platforms, with GCP specialization and exposure to AWS or Azure in multi-cloud environments. GCP certifications such as Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Data Engineer, Professional Machine Learning Engineer, or related credentials. Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or life sciences, including domain ontologies, data models, compliance needs, and knowledge-driven use cases. External client-facing consulting experience, proposal support, solution shaping, or pre-sales exposure. Capture and translate expert and unstructured knowledge into ontologies, knowledge graphs, and semantic models, ensuring accuracy and context for automation and insights. Apply advanced analytics on knowledge graphs to drive problem-solving and actionable insights. Must have skills : Google Cloud Data Services Good to have skills : Data Engineering, Graph Databases, Neo4j Minimum 15 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Role Summary / Description AI Powered Tech Talent Technical Architect role in Knowledge Engineering focused on leading enterprise-scale knowledge graph, semantic layer, ontology, and AI knowledge architecture solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The role owns the complete knowledge engineering scope for strategic and complex programs, sets architecture standards, guides teams, shapes client solutions, and translates real-world business problems into scalable AI and knowledge graph solutions. The role must bring industry experience across domains such as BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or life sciences, applying semantic AI, knowledge graphs, LLM grounding, governed data products, and cloud-native architecture patterns to create reusable assets and measurable business value. Key Responsibilities Define GCP reference architectures for knowledge graph, semantic layer, and AI knowledge applications using services such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Dataproc, Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, IAM, Cloud Logging/Monitoring, and graph/vector ecosystem services. Architect cloud-native data pipelines, graph ingestion, ontology management, vector/database integrations, API layers, LLM grounding patterns, and governed knowledge access models on GCP. Lead the complete Knowledge Graph and Knowledge Engineering solution scope that transforms data architecture for strategic, complex client programs. Own the design, development, and implementation of AI, semantic layer, ontology, taxonomy, schema, graph modeling, and knowledge curation solutions across the program. Partner with project leaders, delivery leads, senior client stakeholders, architects, product teams, data engineers, AI engineers, and domain SMEs to create standout graph-powered offerings. Develop trusted-advisor relationships with senior client stakeholders and make a clear business case for semantic layer, knowledge graph, and enterprise AI knowledge architecture solutions. Lead architecture governance, design reviews, solution estimation, pre-sales support, proposal inputs, implementation planning, and technical risk management for complex knowledge engineering programs. Set standards for ontology design, semantic modeling, metadata management, data governance, lineage, knowledge graph curation, and reusable engineering patterns across programs. Build and mentor multidisciplinary teams, establish capability development plans, and guide delivery quality for knowledge engineers, data engineers, AI engineers, and platform specialists. Drive thought leadership, innovation, reusable assets, accelerators, and modern methods around knowledge graphs, semantic AI, LLM grounding, RAG, agentic systems, and graph-based AI patterns. Translate industry-specific business problems into scalable knowledge-driven architectures and reusable assets that advance the discipline beyond a single engagement. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field. Minimum 6 years of experience with Knowledge Graph technologies such as RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL, OWL, schema design, ontology management, and knowledge graph curation. Minimum 6 years of experience in schema design, ontology management, semantic modeling, taxonomy management, metadata management, and knowledge graph curation. Minimum 4 years of experience designing and developing Knowledge Graph solutions and graph-based ML models across functional and technical workstreams. Minimum 3 years of experience implementing end-to-end data pipelines for AI applications, especially LLM-enabled or enterprise knowledge applications, with hands-on design and configuration. Minimum 6 years of experience with relational databases, object stores, graph databases such as Stardog, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune or equivalent, and vector databases. Minimum 6 years of managerial or technical leadership experience leading teams and explaining the value of semantic layers and knowledge graphs to senior business and technology stakeholders. Experience contributing to sales, pre-sales, solution shaping, delivery leadership, stakeholder management, and enterprise data transformation programs. Required Skills/ Experience Deep knowledge of knowledge graph architecture, semantic modeling, ontology engineering, metadata management, data governance, graph curation, and graph-based AI/ML patterns. Hands-on experience architecting GCP-based knowledge engineering solutions using BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Dataproc, Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, IAM, APIs, and cloud security/monitoring services. Strong Python expertise and hands-on experience with frameworks and tools such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, PySpark, Apache Airflow, Apache NiFi, SQL, SPARQL, SHACL, APIs, and ETL/ELT pipelines. Ability to design scalable graph ingestion, schema/ontology pipelines, semantic data products, vector search/retrieval patterns, RAG grounding layers, and LLM-ready knowledge services. Strong architecture leadership across cloud integration, data pipelines, security, governance, observability, cost optimization, reusable assets, and production readiness. Good to Have Skills Practical experience with NLP techniques, search techniques, prompt engineering, entity extraction, entity resolution, semantic search, and enterprise-scale LLM applications. 5+ years of hands-on experience with cloud platforms, with deep GCP specialization and working exposure to AWS or Azure in multi-cloud environments. GCP certifications such as Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Data Engineer, Professional Machine Learning Engineer, or related credentials. Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or life sciences, including industry-specific ontologies, data models, compliance needs, and knowledge-driven use cases. Advanced degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline. 15 years full time education About Accenture Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. The role works hands-on across the knowledge graph lifecycle from ingestion through modeling, curation, implementation, integration, and deployment. The role applies current methodologies, generative AI, LLM, multimodal, graph, search, and semantic techniques to practical business problems while collaborating with users, use case representatives, engineers, architects, UI designers, and delivery teams. description: Job Title - Decision Science Practitioner Consultant S&C GN Management Level: Consultant Location: Bangalore/ Kolkata/Gurugram/Hyderabad Must have skills: Data Modelling, Conceptual & Logical Design, Semantic Modelling and Understanding of Knowledge Graphs Good to have skills: Data Science, Ontologies, AI/ML Data Enablement, GenAI Foundations Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Consultant Data Modeler to design, develop, and support the maintenance of conceptual, logical, physical, and semantic data models that support advanced analytics, AI/ML, and Generative AI use cases. The consultant will work closely with domain experts/business stakeholders, data science/engineering teams to translate complex business and system knowledge into scalable, high-quality data and semantic models. These models will serve as foundational assets enabling analytics, decision science, AI-driven insights, and intelligent automation across enterprise platforms. The role requires strong collaboration skills and the ability to work across multiple client environments. Key Responsibilities Project and Team Leadership Collaborate with business stakeholders and domain experts to understand data requirements and translate them into clear conceptual, logical, and physical data models. Work closely with data engineers, analytics teams, and AI/ML practitioners to ensure data models are aligned with downstream consumption needs. Aptitude to work independently on modeling workstreams within client engagements, including requirements gathering, design, and documentation. Document & communicate modeling decisions, trade-offs, and best practices to both technical and non-technical audiences. Contribute to project delivery through high-quality, low-defect delivery”, documentation, design reviews, and model governance activities. Data Modelling & Semantic Modelling Expertise Design and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models for structured and semi-structured data across enterprise systems. Develop reusable, extensible data models supporting analytics, reporting, AI/ML feature engineering, and decision science use cases. Apply semantic modeling techniques, including domain modeling, entity relationships, hierarchies, and taxonomies. Enable ontology and knowledge graph modeling, translating subject-matter knowledge into machine-readable representations. Ensure alignment of data models with enterprise architecture principles, data standards, and best practices. AI & GenAI Enablement Design data and semantic models that act as foundational datasets for AI/ML and Generative AI systems. Enable explainability, reasoning, and contextual grounding through ontology-driven approaches and graph-based data models. Partner with data science and AI teams to ensure models support feature reuse, RAG pipelines, and intelligent agent workflows. Contribute to data model designs that improve trust, interpretability, and scalability of AI-driven solutions. Data Governance & Standards Follow and contribute to data modeling standards, naming conventions, and design guidelines across projects. Support data governance initiatives including metadata management, lineage, and documentation. Ensure consistency, quality, and reusability of data assets across platforms and use cases. Business Impact and Innovation Translate complex business concepts into clear, well-structured data models that accelerate analytics and AI adoption. Enable faster solution development by providing high-quality, well-documented data foundations. Support measurable outcomes by improving data usability, consistency, and decision-making effectiveness. Required Qualifications Experience 4–6 years of experience with 3+ years of hands-on experience in data modelling, information modelling, or data architecture roles. Experience designing conceptual, logical, and physical data models. Experience working in consulting or client-facing roles is highly preferred. Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. Technical Skills Strong expertise in data modeling techniques and methodologies. Proficiency with data modeling tools (ER modeling tools, UML, or equivalent) is preferred. Experience working with relational and graph-based data models. Familiarity with semantic modeling concepts, ontologies, or knowledge graphs (e.g., RDF/OWL concepts). Ability to collaborate effectively with data engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders. Preferred Skills Exposure to knowledge graph technologies (e.g., Neo4j or similar). Familiarity with AI/ML and GenAI consumption patterns, including feature stores, RAG pipelines, and agentic systems. Experience defining data standards and governance frameworks. Prior experience supporting analytics, decision science, or AI-driven initiatives.
